title: The Cost of Re-Explanation Repeated Explanatory Labor as an Unpriced Organizational Cost

detail.title: The Cost of Re-Explanation Repeated Explanatory Labor as an Unpriced Organizational Cost

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational relationships that could be perceived as inappropriately influencing or biasing the research presented in this paper. This work was conducted independently as part of the author's academic research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The preliminary qualitative evidence and interview data presented in this study (Appendix D) were collected through voluntary, anonymized professional interactions for conceptual validation. No sensitive personal information or clinical participants were involved, and all contributors provided informed consent for their anonymized professional perspectives to be used for research purposes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and did not receive any specific grants or financial support from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Repeated explanation is a pervasive feature of knowledge-intensive work, as professionals routinely re-explain tasks, decisions, and contextual information to multiple organizational actors across meetings, digital communication, handovers, and onboarding processes. Despite its ubiquity in coordination-intensive settings such as consulting, engineering, and product development, this explanatory effort remains largely invisible, unmeasured, and unpriced within organizational systems. Such explanatory labor entails substantial time expenditure, cognitive effort, and attentional demands, yet these costs are rarely recognized by organizational accounting practices or performance metrics. Existing research on coordination costs, invisible labor, and cognitive load addresses related dynamics but does so in fragmented ways, leaving the phenomenon of repeated explanatory labor theoretically underdeveloped. In particular, the literature lacks a distinct construct and an integrative model capable of capturing repeated explanation as a form of organizational work and an accumulating organizational cost. Adopting a conceptual development approach, this paper employs a structured model-building strategy grounded in established traditions of organizational theory. We introduce and formally define Repeated Explanatory Labor as iterative, context-dependent explanatory acts that recur across multiple episodes, audiences, or organizational periods such that explanatory demands cannot be resolved through a single clarification event or standard formal knowledge transfer mechanism-indicating structural persistence of the underlying organizational condition generating the demand. We develop an integrated conceptual model that specifies key antecedents, underlying cognitive and attentional processes, and individual and organizational outcomes. Finally, we advance a set of formal propositions linking these elements, offering a foundation for future empirical research and highlighting a hidden yet consequential cost embedded in knowledge work coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"重复解释劳动"这一新概念，指专业人士在组织协调中反复向不同对象解释任务、决策和背景信息的现象。这种解释劳动虽然普遍存在且耗费大量时间和认知资源，但在组织系统中往往不可见、无法测量且未被定价。论文建立了整合的概念模型来解释其前因、过程和后果。
AI.research_question: 如何概念化和建模知识密集型工作中普遍存在但未被充分认识的重复解释劳动现象？
AI.motivation: 重复解释在咨询、工程和产品开发等协调密集型环境中普遍存在，但这种解释努力在组织系统中基本不可见、无法测量且未被定价。现有研究对协调成本、隐性劳动和认知负荷的关注是分散的，缺乏对重复解释劳动这一现象的理论发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织理论、协调成本理论、隐性劳动理论、认知负荷理论
AI.method: 概念发展方法，采用基于组织理论传统的结构化模型构建策略
AI.findings: 提出了"重复解释劳动"的正式定义：迭代的、情境依赖的解释行为，在多个事件、受众或组织时期中重复出现，无法通过单一澄清事件或标准正式知识转移机制解决。开发了整合的概念模型，明确了关键前因、认知和注意力过程以及个体和组织结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了"重复解释劳动"这一新概念；2) 建立了整合的概念模型；3) 提出了一系列正式命题；4) 为未来实证研究奠定了基础；5) 揭示了知识工作协调中隐藏但重要的成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 使组织能够识别和测量重复解释劳动；2) 帮助管理者理解协调中的隐性成本；3) 为改进知识转移机制提供理论基础；4) 提高对专业人员认知负荷的认识；5) 为组织绩效评估提供新视角。

title: The Six Sigma Sales Leader: Architecting Efficiency in the Revenue Engine

detail.title: The Six Sigma Sales Leader: Architecting Efficiency in the Revenue Engine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Shawn Hamilton, declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The author is a certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and an active practitioner in the field of sales leadership with over 30 years of experience in the capital equipment, industrial manufacturing, and oil & gas sectors. The insights presented herein are derived from professional practice and academic research conducted as an EDBA candidate at the University of Houston.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Historically, sales leadership has been characterized as an art form driven by intuition and personality, resisting the operational rigor applied to other organizational functions. This paper argues that the traditional "hero leader" model is increasingly unsustainable in an era of lengthening sales cycles and diminishing returns on digital outreach. By redefining sales leadership through the lens of Organizational Architecture Theory, this article proposes the integration of Lean Six Sigma (LSS) methodologies to reduce variability in leadership execution without stifling the creative autonomy of sales producers.

The author outlines a framework for applying the DMAIC model (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) specifically to the behavioral layer of sales management. This approach shifts focus from lag metrics, such as quota attainment, to process-oriented inputs, such as "Leadership Standard Work" and a "Leadership Process Capability Index." The paper further addresses the "Creativity Paradox," demonstrating how distinguishing between wasteful variation (inconsistent process) and value-added variation (creative negotiation) allows organizations to standardize the "flight deck" while leaving the "flying" to the artist. Ultimately, the paper posits that architecting a standardized, measurable leadership process is the next frontier for sustainable revenue growth and competitive advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将精益六西格玛方法应用于销售领导力管理，通过DMAIC模型减少领导力执行中的变异性，同时保留销售人员的创造性自主权，旨在解决传统"英雄式领导"模式在销售周期延长和数字外联回报递减时代不可持续的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将精益六西格玛方法论应用于销售领导力管理，在减少领导力执行变异性的同时保持销售人员的创造性自主权？
AI.motivation: 传统销售领导力被视为依赖直觉和个性的艺术形式，缺乏其他组织职能所应用的运营严谨性。在销售周期延长和数字外联回报递减的时代，传统的"英雄式领导"模式越来越不可持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织架构理论（Organizational Architecture Theory）和精益六西格玛（Lean Six Sigma）方法论，特别是DMAIC模型（定义、测量、分析、改进、控制）。
AI.method: 提出将DMAIC模型应用于销售管理行为层的框架，从滞后指标（如配额达成）转向流程导向的输入指标，包括"领导标准工作"和"领导流程能力指数"。
AI.findings: 通过区分浪费性变异（不一致的流程）和价值增值变异（创造性谈判），组织可以标准化"驾驶舱"（管理流程）同时让"飞行"（销售执行）保持艺术性，解决"创造力悖论"。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织架构理论与精益六西格玛方法相结合，为销售领导力研究提供了新的理论视角；提出了"创造力悖论"的解决方案框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为销售组织提供了可操作的框架，通过标准化、可测量的领导流程实现可持续收入增长和竞争优势；帮助管理者平衡流程标准化与创造性自主权。

title:
The First Principles of Choice 
A Human-Centered Methodology for Ye-Jie Innovation under Uncertainty
affiliations: Fan Ge Institute

detail.title:
The First Principles of Choice 
A Human-Centered Methodology for Ye-Jie Innovation under Uncertainty
detail.abstract:
In contexts of radical uncertainty, innovation failure is more often the result of poor choices than insufficient capabilities. Many innovations collapse not because they lack technical sophistication or executional competence, but because the initial strategic choices are misaligned with human behavior, value sustainability, and long-term cooperation.

This paper argues that choice constitutes the most critical and least understood element of Ye-Jie innovation. To address this problem, it proposes a first-principles framework grounded not in technology, markets, or institutions alone, but in human nature as a stable, cross-cultural, and cross-cyclical foundation. Human nature is analytically decomposed into a relatively stable demand layer and a volatile impulse layer, enabling a distinction between choices that scale temporarily and those that endure over time.

Building on this foundation, the paper introduces a multi-layered selection methodology for Ye-Jie innovation, integrating human constraints, structural boundary conditions, evolutionary dynamics, and attractor formation. The study further clarifies the concept of attractors as indicators of emergent system stability rather than ex-post success. By reframing choice as a problem of human-centered value sustainability rather than possibility maximization, the paper provides a principled decision framework for innovation under deep uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于人性的第一性原理框架，用于解决叶界创新中的战略选择问题，强调选择比能力更重要，创新失败常源于选择不当而非能力不足。
AI.research_question: 在极端不确定性下，叶界创新如何做出能够持久而非仅暂时有效的战略选择？
AI.motivation: 许多创新失败不是因为技术或执行能力不足，而是因为初始战略选择与人类行为、价值可持续性和长期合作不匹配。选择是叶界创新中最关键但最不被理解的要素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人性的第一性原理框架，将人性分解为相对稳定的需求层和易变的冲动层，区分暂时性扩展和持久性选择。引入吸引子概念作为涌现系统稳定性的指标。
AI.method: 多层选择方法论，整合人类约束、结构边界条件、进化动力学和吸引子形成，将选择重新定义为以人为中心的价值可持续性问题而非可能性最大化问题。
AI.findings: 通过基于人性的分析框架，能够区分哪些选择会暂时扩展而哪些会持久存在，为深度不确定性下的创新提供原则性决策框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于人性的叶界创新第一性原理框架；2) 将人性分解为稳定需求层和易变冲动层；3) 重新定义吸引子为涌现系统稳定性的指标而非事后成功标志；4) 将选择问题重构为价值可持续性而非可能性最大化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创新者提供在极端不确定性下做出持久有效战略选择的决策框架，帮助避免因选择不当导致的创新失败，提高创新的长期可持续性。

title: False Cognitive Power Transfer

detail.title: False Cognitive Power Transfer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without any institutional or commercial affiliations that might bias the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on theoretical modeling, Monte Carlo simulations using synthetic agents, and the analysis of secondary data available in the public domain. As the research did not involve human participants in clinical trials or the collection of private personal data, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. All resources required for research, modeling, and simulations were self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) produces a significant cognitive paradox: while exponentially amplifying the capabilities of experts, it simultaneously generates a dangerous illusion of competence in inexperienced users. This paper introduces and formalizes the concept of False Cognitive Power Transfer (FCPT) - a phenomenon whereby individuals mistakenly attribute the efficiency and speed of AI outputs to their own cognitive competence. This misattribution leads to a systematic over-commitment to tasks and responsibilities that exceed the user's actual capacity for systemic management.
FCPT triggers two distinct collective failure mechanisms:
- Collective Demoralization Cascade (CDC): where spectacular failures rooted in unrealistic expectations lead to the preemptive abandonment of viable initiatives by the broader community.
- Replication Illusion (RI): where the observed success of experts is attributed solely to the AI tool, creating overconfidence in the ease of replication while ignoring the invisible human expertise required to guide the process.
In the long term, this research demonstrates that these mechanisms lead to cognitive atrophy - the progressive loss of original, deep-thinking capacity, a risk that affects even high-level experts (L3) through a growing dependency on AI-generated patterns. As a countermeasure, the paper proposes and validates through Monte Carlo simulations the Mechanism of Cognitive Stimulation (MCS), part of the MEG (Minimal Ethical Governance) standard. This intervention ensures the maintenance of human cognitive effort (Tb) relative to the machine's thinking time (Tg).
This work is part of a broader body of independent research on cognitive divergence and the social impact of human-AI symbiosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"虚假认知权力转移(FCPT)"概念，指用户误将AI输出的效率归因于自身认知能力，导致系统性过度承诺。这引发两种集体失败机制：集体士气崩溃级联(CDC)和复制幻觉(RI)，长期导致认知萎缩。作为对策，提出认知刺激机制(MCS)作为MEG标准的一部分。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何通过虚假认知权力转移(FCPT)现象影响用户认知能力，以及如何通过认知刺激机制(MCS)来缓解这种负面影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在增强专家能力的同时，给缺乏经验的用户带来危险的能力幻觉，导致系统性过度承诺和认知风险，需要研究其机制和应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虚假认知权力转移(FCPT)理论、集体士气崩溃级联(CDC)、复制幻觉(RI)、认知萎缩理论、认知刺激机制(MCS)、最小伦理治理(MEG)标准。
AI.method: 概念形式化、理论构建、蒙特卡洛模拟验证认知刺激机制(MCS)的有效性。
AI.findings: FCPT导致用户系统性过度承诺；CDC和RI是两种集体失败机制；长期导致认知萎缩，影响包括高级专家在内的所有用户；MCS能有效维持人类认知努力与机器思考时间的平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次形式化FCPT概念；识别CDC和RI两种集体失败机制；提出认知萎缩理论；建立MCS作为MEG标准的一部分；丰富人机共生社会影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计提供伦理指导；帮助组织识别和预防FCPT风险；为AI培训和教育提供框架；为政策制定者提供治理标准；帮助用户保持认知能力。

title: Escaping the Cost-Quality Trap: Strategic Configurations and Behavioral Microfoundations of Competitive Advantage in Resource-Constrained MSEs

detail.title: Escaping the Cost-Quality Trap: Strategic Configurations and Behavioral Microfoundations of Competitive Advantage in Resource-Constrained MSEs
detail.abstract: Conventional strategy theory posits a trade-off between cost leadership and quality differentiation, yet many micro and small enterprises (MSEs) sustain competitive pricing without eroding perceived or actual quality under severe resource constraints. This study challenges this dichotomy by identifying strategic configurations-capability development and process innovations-and behavioral microfoundations-leadership, communication, and conflict regulation-that enable MSEs to escape the cost-quality trap. Using a mixed-methods design with quasi-experimental identification from policy shocks and registry data, combined with longitudinal case studies, we find that behavioral mechanisms moderate the effectiveness of strategic configurations, particularly in small, informal settings. Results show that these mechanisms are conditional on firm size, age, and institutional context, extending capability theory and behavioral strategy to low-routinized contexts. Implications for theory and MSE managers are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究挑战了传统战略理论中成本领先与质量差异化的权衡观点，发现微型和小型企业通过能力发展、流程创新等战略配置，以及领导力、沟通、冲突调节等行为微观基础，能够在资源约束下实现成本与质量的双重优势。
AI.research_question: 微型和小型企业如何在严重资源约束下，既保持竞争性定价又不损害感知或实际质量，从而摆脱成本-质量陷阱？
AI.motivation: 传统战略理论认为成本领先与质量差异化存在权衡，但许多微型和小型企业在实践中能够同时实现两者，这与理论预测不符，需要探究其背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力理论、行为战略理论、战略配置理论、资源基础观
AI.method: 混合方法设计：利用政策冲击和注册数据的准实验识别，结合纵向案例研究
AI.findings: 1. 战略配置（能力发展和流程创新）与行为微观基础（领导力、沟通、冲突调节）共同使微型和小型企业摆脱成本-质量陷阱；2. 行为机制调节战略配置的有效性，尤其在小型非正式环境中；3. 这些机制的效果受企业规模、年龄和制度环境的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展能力理论和行为战略理论到低常规化情境；2. 挑战传统战略理论中的成本-质量权衡观点；3. 识别战略配置与行为微观基础的互动机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为微型和小型企业管理者提供同时实现成本和质量优势的具体策略；2. 强调领导力、沟通和冲突调节等行为因素的重要性；3. 提供基于企业特征和制度环境的差异化建议

title: Irreversible Creative Capital and Endogenous Rational Non-intervention: When Economic Rationality Requires Non-intervention
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Irreversible Creative Capital and Endogenous Rational Non-intervention: When Economic Rationality Requires Non-intervention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper identifies the conditions under which governance intervention—commonly treated as a default instrument of economic rationality—cannot be presumed to operate as a neutral or corrective mechanism when value creation depends on Irreversible Creative Capital (ICC). ICC is introduced as a distinct form of capital constituted by irreversible, time-based commitment of finite human life to creative activity under irreducible uncertainty and ex-ante non-contractibility. Unlike conventional human capital, ICC entails permanent foreclosure of option value, as commitment to a specific creative trajectory necessarily forecloses alternative paths that cannot be recovered or diversified ex post.
The analysis shows that in high-ICC environments, evaluative and directive interventions oriented toward short-term accountability necessarily rely on proxy indicators and early validation signals. Optimization toward such proxies contracts exploratory space and forecloses latent creative trajectories whose value can only be realized over longer horizons. Because ICC is formed through irreversible lifetime commitment, this contraction imposes permanent opportunity costs on future creative potential and alters the capital structure underlying value creation.
The paper formalizes Endogenous Rational Non-intervention (ERNI) as a conditional governance outcome in which restraint from evaluative and directive intervention emerges endogenously as a rational response to the structure of value creation rather than as laissez-faire or institutional passivity. When ICC constitutes a primary source of value creation under irreducible uncertainty and non-contractibility, actors may maximize long-term expected value by limiting their own interventionist capacities. The framework yields comparative and testable implications for outcome distributions, exploratory diversity, and selection dynamics across governance regimes in ICC-intensive environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"不可逆创造性资本"概念，发现在高ICC环境中，基于短期问责的治理干预会压缩探索空间，导致永久性机会成本。作者形式化了"内生理性非干预"作为最优治理策略。
AI.research_question: 在不可逆创造性资本构成价值创造主要来源的环境中，治理干预何时无法作为中性或纠正机制运作？
AI.motivation: 传统治理理论将干预视为经济理性的默认工具，但在创造性活动中，这种假设可能不成立。需要理解当价值创造依赖于不可逆的、基于时间的创造性承诺时，治理干预的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不可逆创造性资本理论、内生理性非干预理论、治理理论、期权理论（机会成本视角）
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，形式化建模，比较分析不同治理制度下的结果分布、探索多样性和选择动态
AI.findings: 在高ICC环境中，基于短期问责的治理干预会依赖代理指标和早期验证信号，压缩探索空间，永久性地排除潜在的创造性轨迹，对未来的创造性潜力造成永久性机会成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出不可逆创造性资本概念；2) 形式化内生理性非干预作为条件性治理结果；3) 提供可检验的比较框架，分析不同治理制度在ICC密集环境中的表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创造性密集型组织（如研究机构、艺术团体、创新企业）的治理设计提供指导，建议在特定条件下采取克制干预的策略以最大化长期价值创造。

title: Fiscal Insurance
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and Boston College, Carroll School of Management

detail.title: Fiscal Insurance
detail.abstract: We show that government policies interact in ways that shape how capital markets price risk. We introduce the concept of fiscal insurance: a mechanism through which certain fiscal tools are perceived by investors to mitigate the risks created by other government policies. Exploiting the 2018-19 U.S. tariff shocks and concurrent federal procurement spending, we find that firms facing higher tariff exposure earn higher risk premia, but this effect is substantially attenuated for firms receiving greater procurement. Procurement itself increases more for politically connected and economically vulnerable firms, revealing both political and economic channels of fiscal insurance. Overall, our evidence documents the existence of fiscal insurance, a cross-policy mechanism, with implications for firm valuation and real activity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"财政保险"概念，即某些财政工具被投资者视为可以减轻其他政府政策所创造风险的机制。利用2018-19年美国关税冲击和联邦采购支出数据，研究发现关税暴露高的企业风险溢价更高，但获得更多政府采购的企业这一效应显著减弱。
AI.research_question: 政府政策如何相互作用影响资本市场对风险的定价？具体而言，财政政策（如政府采购）能否作为"保险"机制来减轻其他政策（如关税）带来的风险？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常孤立地分析单个政策的影响，但现实中政府政策往往同时实施并相互影响。理解政策间的相互作用对于全面评估政策效果至关重要，特别是在资本市场如何定价政策风险方面。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 财政保险理论：某些财政工具被投资者视为可以减轻其他政策风险的保险机制
2. 政策相互作用理论：不同政府政策之间存在协同或抵消效应
3. 风险定价理论：资本市场如何将政策风险纳入资产定价
AI.method: 利用2018-19年美国关税冲击作为准自然实验，结合联邦政府采购数据，采用双重差分法分析关税暴露对企业风险溢价的影响，以及政府采购如何调节这一关系。同时分析政府采购分配的政治和经济决定因素。
AI.findings:
1. 关税暴露高的企业风险溢价更高
2. 政府采购显著减弱了关税暴露对风险溢价的正向影响
3. 政府采购更多流向政治关联企业和经济脆弱企业，揭示了财政保险的政治和经济渠道
4. 财政保险机制对企业估值和实际经济活动有重要影响
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次提出"财政保险"概念，丰富了政策相互作用理论
2. 建立了跨政策风险缓释的理论框架
3. 拓展了资本市场如何定价复合政策风险的理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了政策协调的重要启示
2. 帮助企业理解如何通过政府采购等渠道减轻政策风险
3. 为投资者提供了评估政策风险的新视角
4. 揭示了政策实施中的政治和经济考量

title: Advancing AI Governance: Designing Compliance Frameworks that Strengthen Data Protection and Foster Innovation
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Advancing AI Governance: Designing Compliance Frameworks that Strengthen Data Protection and Foster Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with individuals or organizations that have influenced or could be perceived to have influenced the study’s content and conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: As this study did not involve human participants or case studies, no formal ethics approval was required for this research work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) across critical sectors has intensified the need for governance models that effectively protect data, uphold ethical standards, and sustain technological innovation. Despite AI's transformative potential, existing governance frameworks remain fragmented and inconsistent, leaving significant risks insufficiently addressed, including privacy violations, algorithmic bias, opacity, and human rights concerns. This paper examines the evolution of AI governance frameworks across jurisdictions and identifies structural and regulatory gaps that hinder effective oversight and governance. Employing a multidisciplinary analytical approach that integrates legal scholarship, policy analysis, ethics, and computational theory, the study proposes an integrated AI compliance framework designed to translate high-level ethical principles into operational practice. The findings reveal persistent weaknesses in current regulatory models and underscore the importance of lifecycle-based compliance mechanisms incorporating transparency, accountability, equity, safety, and data protection. The proposed framework offers practical guidance for policymakers, corporations, nonprofit organizations, and public-interest actors seeking to deploy AI responsibly. The paper concludes that robust governance and compliance structures are essential not only for safeguarding individual rights but also for fostering sustainable innovation and maintaining long-term trust in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个整合性AI合规框架，将高层伦理原则转化为可操作的实践，以解决当前AI治理碎片化问题，确保数据保护、伦理标准和创新可持续性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建有效的AI治理框架，以解决当前监管碎片化问题，将伦理原则转化为可操作的合规实践？
AI.motivation: AI在关键领域的快速扩张需要有效的治理模型来保护数据、维护伦理标准和维持技术创新。现有治理框架碎片化且不一致，未能充分解决隐私侵犯、算法偏见、不透明性和人权关切等风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合法律学术、政策分析、伦理学和计算理论的多学科分析框架，强调透明度、问责制、公平性、安全性和数据保护等核心原则。
AI.method: 采用多学科分析方法，考察不同司法管辖区AI治理框架的演变，识别结构和监管缺口，提出整合性AI合规框架。
AI.findings: 当前监管模型存在持续弱点，基于生命周期的合规机制（包含透明度、问责制、公平性、安全性和数据保护）对于有效治理至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将高层伦理原则转化为可操作实践的整合性AI合规框架理论，填补了现有治理框架的结构性和监管性缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业、非营利组织和公共利益相关者提供部署负责任AI的实践指导，促进可持续创新和长期信任。

title: Why Inventory Models Fail at the Execution Level: Internal Decision Lead Time, Hierarchical Constraints, and Procurement Reality in Emerging Markets

detail.abstract: Traditional inventory models such as the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) and reorder point (ROP) structure assumes that replenishment decisions can be implemented immediately once predefined threshold points are attained or reached. However, in practical environment, inventory failures continuously occurs even when these models are applied at correct place at correct time with proper application method. This study brings up that such failures stem from a systematic underestimation of effective lead time. Traditional models have treated lead time only as a external drive from suppliers, neglecting any form of deterministic delay within organization associated with approval process, budget constraints and hierarchical structures used for organizational decision making purposes. Based upon a revision of classical inventory theory via classical inventory theory, bounded rationality and the emerging supply chain literature from both developing and emerging markets, this paper extends and improves the reorder point inventory model by adding an internal decision lead time. A numerical model is provided to illustrate the negative consequences of not including lead times for internal decisions. As a result of not including internal lead times for example, premature stockouts, emergency procurement and execution level cost increases occurred as a direct result. Therefore, we argue there is a need for awareness in inventory models pertaining to execution and also, educational procurement in consideration of organizational realities within the context of an emerging market.

AI.tldr: 传统库存模型（如EOQ和ROP）假设补货决策能在达到阈值时立即实施，但实践中仍会出现库存失效。研究发现这是由于系统性低估了有效前置时间，传统模型仅将前置时间视为供应商外部驱动，忽略了组织内部审批流程、预算约束和层级结构等确定性延迟。本文通过扩展ROP模型，加入内部决策前置时间，揭示了忽略内部前置时间会导致过早缺货、紧急采购和成本增加等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何改进传统库存模型以考虑组织内部决策延迟对有效前置时间的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统库存模型（EOQ、ROP）在实践中即使正确应用仍会出现库存失效，这是因为这些模型假设补货决策能立即实施，而忽略了组织内部审批流程、预算约束和层级结构等造成的确定性延迟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典库存理论、有限理性理论、新兴市场供应链文献
AI.method: 通过修订经典库存理论，扩展和改进再订货点库存模型，加入内部决策前置时间，并提供数值模型说明忽略内部决策前置时间的负面后果
AI.findings: 忽略内部决策前置时间会导致过早缺货、紧急采购和执行层面成本增加等直接后果
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统库存模型，将组织内部决策延迟纳入前置时间考虑，提供了更符合组织现实的库存管理理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提高库存模型对执行层面的认识，考虑新兴市场组织现实的教育采购，帮助企业避免因忽略内部决策延迟而导致的库存失效问题

title: Impact of AI-Driven Revenue Management Systems on the Financial Performance in Hospitality Industry? A Systematic Literature Review

detail.title: Impact of AI-Driven Revenue Management Systems on the Financial Performance in Hospitality Industry? A Systematic Literature Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no conflict of interest

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the transformative role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the revenue management systems of the hospitality industry to highlight the significant effect of AI on the financial performance. By systematically reviewing the literature spanning 2008 to 2023, the study outlines significant contributions, developments, applications, and impacts of AI technologies on revenue, economic growth, and profitability in this sector. The findings of the study indicate that the application of AI-enhanced systems increases the effectiveness of innovations implemented in revenue management by increasing efficiency in setting competitive prices depending on the time of year and demand for services, as well as in demand prediction and the allocation of resources that leads to stable financial performance. Ultimately, this study supports the argument that prudent investment in artificial intelligence-driven systems can successfully navigate the complexities of modern revenue management, guarantee profitability, and improve customer happiness in the hospitality business. Besides, the study seeks to identify innovative AI solutions and approaches to the emerging revenue management systems that are dynamic in character and stresses the importance of collaboration between AI systems and humans in decision-making processes. The findings of this study also hold useful lessons for industry players: they should embrace the adoption of AI innovations if they are to record sustainable financial success within a growing, competitive environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述探讨AI在酒店业收益管理系统中的变革作用，发现AI增强系统能提高定价效率、需求预测和资源分配，从而改善财务绩效和客户满意度。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在酒店业收益管理系统中扮演什么变革性角色？AI如何影响该行业的财务绩效？
AI.motivation: 随着酒店业竞争加剧和收益管理复杂性增加，需要探索AI技术如何帮助行业应对现代收益管理的挑战，提高财务绩效和客户满意度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于收益管理理论、技术创新采纳理论和动态能力理论，探讨AI如何增强酒店业的定价策略、需求预测和资源分配能力。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，分析2008年至2023年间关于AI在酒店业收益管理中应用的文献。
AI.findings: AI增强系统能显著提高收益管理创新的有效性，包括季节性定价效率、需求预测准确性和资源分配优化，从而带来稳定的财务绩效。AI与人类协作在决策过程中至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了收益管理理论，强调了AI作为动态能力的重要性；深化了技术创新采纳理论在酒店业的应用；提出了AI-人类协作决策的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店业从业者提供AI采纳的具体指导；强调投资AI驱动系统的重要性；提出AI与人类协作的实践建议；为行业在竞争环境中实现可持续财务成功提供路径。

title: Measuring Dialogue, Managing Unity: A KPI-Governed Performance analysis of al-Murājaʿāt Using a Design-Science Approach
affiliations: , University of Religions and Denominations, University of Religions and Denominations, University of Religions and Denominations and University of Religions and Denominations

detail.title: Measuring Dialogue, Managing Unity: A KPI-Governed Performance analysis of al-Murājaʿāt Using a Design-Science Approach
detail.abstract:
This study converts the 112-letter corpus of al-Murājaʿāt into an auditable
performance system and validates a KPI-governed Unity Index. Addressing
the absence of scalable measures for dialogical ethics, cross-school evidence flows, and institutional uptake, we adopt a mixed-methods design:
AI-assisted content coding and discourse analysis at letter level; evidence-
flow modeling to quantify cross-citation and Qurʾān–Sunnah
harmonization; and psychometric validation (inter-coder reliability,
EFA→CFA) to confirm domain structure. Findings show consistently high
Dialogue-Ethics performance (e.g., respectful tone, rebuttal without
derision), strong Cross-Reliance on Sunni authorities with sustained
harmonization signals, and comparatively weak
Institutionalization/Education and Governance/RACI domains (e.g.,
curriculum inclusion, reviewer participation, documentation completeness).
The Unity Index integrates these dynamics, revealing that civility and
shared-authority sourcing lift composite scores while limited organizational
adoption constrains long-run impact. Theoretically, the work advances a
measurement theory of dialogical kalām by specifying observable variables
with reliability targets and thresholds. Practically, it provides governance-
ready dashboards for curriculum policy, program accreditation, public
communication risk control, and continuous improvement. The framework
transfers to adjacent management contexts: service-quality gates and
compliance dashboards in airline management; stakeholder-trust controls in
tourism and health tourism; and explainable, validated KPI programs in
digital transformation initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究将112封信件的al-Murājaʿāt语料库转化为可审计的绩效系统，验证了KPI治理的统一指数。研究发现对话伦理表现高，跨教派依赖强，但制度化和治理领域较弱。
AI.research_question: 如何开发可扩展的测量方法来评估对话伦理、跨学派证据流动和制度采纳，以促进伊斯兰学术对话的统一性？
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏可扩展的测量方法来评估对话伦理、跨学派证据流动和制度采纳，这限制了伊斯兰学术对话的质量评估和改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对话性凯拉姆（dialogical kalām）测量理论，强调可观察变量、可靠性目标和阈值；跨学派证据流动模型；制度采纳理论。
AI.method: 混合方法设计：AI辅助内容编码和话语分析（信件层面）；证据流动建模（量化交叉引用和古兰经-圣训协调）；心理测量验证（编码者间信度、探索性因子分析→验证性因子分析）。
AI.findings: 对话伦理表现持续高（如尊重语气、反驳不嘲讽）；对逊尼派权威的跨依赖性强且协调信号持续；制度/教育和治理/RACI领域相对较弱（如课程纳入、评审参与、文档完整性）。统一指数显示文明礼貌和共享权威来源提升综合分数，而有限的组织采纳制约长期影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进对话性凯拉姆的测量理论，通过指定具有可靠性目标和阈值的可观察变量；开发统一指数整合对话伦理、证据流动和制度采纳的动态关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供治理就绪的仪表板用于课程政策、项目认证、公共沟通风险控制和持续改进；框架可转移到相邻管理环境：航空管理中的服务质量门控和合规仪表板、旅游和医疗旅游中的利益相关者信任控制、数字化转型中的可解释验证KPI项目。

title: Post-Occupancy Environmental Performance of a Household-Model Residential Aged Care Facility: A Same-Site Sequential Evaluation (Phase 2)
affiliations: Edith Cowan University, Hames Sharley, Independent, Central Queensland University (CQUniversity), Gabriels Hearn Farrell Pty Ltd, Adventist Care, Adventist Care, University of Southern Queensland and University of Southern Queensland

detail.title: Post-Occupancy Environmental Performance of a Household-Model Residential Aged Care Facility: A Same-Site Sequential Evaluation (Phase 2)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. This research does not involve any grants from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained from the ECU Human Research Ethics Committee (Approval #2024-05563-JONESCU).
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Purpose 

Purpose-built residential aged care (RAC) facilities adopting household models are widely promoted as assets that improve environmental quality and resident comfort. However, post-occupancy evidence verifying whether these facilities deliver measurable improvements against health-relevant acoustic, lighting, and thermal benchmarks remains limited. This study reports a Phase 2 postoccupancy evaluation (POE) of a newly constructed household-model RAC facility, comparing realised indoor environmental quality (IEQ) performance and occupant perceptions against established benchmarks and a pre-relocation baseline from the legacy facility it replaced. 

Design/methodology/approach

Environmental monitoring was undertaken over two consecutive 14-day deployments in March 2025 across private bedrooms, communal lounges and dining areas, and transitional spaces. Minuteresolution acoustic, lighting, and temperature data were collected using industry-grade IC-NSRT and HOBO MX2202 loggers. Performance was evaluated against WHO and AS/NZS 2107:2016 acoustic criteria, pragmatic circadian-supportive lighting thresholds (≥1000 lux daytime; ≤10 lux night), and thermal guidance emphasising diurnal variation (≥2 °C) and avoidance of prolonged operation above 22 °C. Parallel surveys of residents, proxies, and staff captured perceived environmental conditions and operational influences.

Findings

Compared with the legacy facility, the household-model building demonstrated clear improvements in night-time acoustic conditions in bedrooms, reduced nocturnal light intrusion, and enhanced daylight availability in communal spaces. Daytime illuminance in bedrooms improved but remained variable, influenced by orientation, shading, and resident use. Thermal conditions were generally cooler and widely perceived as comfortable, with increased diurnal variation evident in some spaces. Survey responses indicated improved satisfaction with acoustic and lighting conditions, while perceptions of thermal comfort remained consistently positive across phases. 

Practical implications

Findings indicate that architectural change can deliver measurable IEQ gains, but that full alignment with health-relevant benchmarks depends on post-handover operational tuning, staff awareness, and adaptive use of environmental controls. Residual performance gaps are best understood as opportunities for optimisation rather than design shortcomings. 

Originality/value 

The study provides rare same-site pre- and post-occupancy evidence of IEQ performance change in residential aged care, integrating objective monitoring with occupant perceptions to support evidence-informed facilities management and post-occupancy optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本研究对新建的家庭式养老设施进行了入住后评估，比较了其室内环境质量与旧设施的表现。结果显示新设施在夜间声学条件、减少夜间光侵扰和增加公共区域自然光方面有明显改善，但完全达到健康相关标准仍需运营调整。
AI.research_question: 新建的家庭式养老设施是否比其替代的旧设施在声学、照明和热环境方面提供了可测量的改善？这些改善是否符合健康相关的基准标准？
AI.motivation: 虽然专门建造的家庭式养老设施被广泛宣传为能改善环境质量和居住舒适度，但缺乏入住后证据验证这些设施是否真正实现了对健康相关的声学、照明和热环境基准的可测量改善。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于室内环境质量评估框架，整合WHO声学标准、AS/NZS 2107:2016声学标准、昼夜节律支持性照明阈值（白天≥1000 lux，夜间≤10 lux），以及强调昼夜变化（≥2°C）和避免长时间超过22°C的热环境指导原则。
AI.method: 采用两阶段研究方法：1) 在2025年3月进行为期14天的环境监测，使用IC-NSRT和HOBO MX2202记录仪收集分钟级声学、照明和温度数据；2) 同时对居民、代理人和工作人员进行问卷调查，收集对环境条件的感知和运营影响。
AI.findings: 与旧设施相比，新设施在卧室夜间声学条件、减少夜间光侵扰和公共区域自然光可用性方面有明显改善。卧室白天照度有所改善但仍存在变化。热环境普遍较凉爽且被认为舒适。调查显示对声学和照明条件的满意度提高，热舒适感知在两阶段均保持积极。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了罕见的同一地点入住前后室内环境质量变化证据，整合了客观监测与居住者感知，支持基于证据的设施管理和入住后优化理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究表明建筑设计变化可以带来可测量的室内环境质量改善，但完全符合健康相关基准需要入住后的运营调整、员工意识和环境控制的自适应使用。剩余的性能差距应被视为优化机会而非设计缺陷。

keywords: Inflation Driven Active Versus Passive Investment Decisions

detail.abstract: Can an alternative valuation architecture replace the traditional IRR/NPV and EBITDA valuation architectures? Meaningful recognition of the universal absence of accounting equity statements in the current three prospective financial statements is limited. However, similar to the four historical primary financial statements and dissimilar to the three prospective primary financial statements, four prospective primary financial statements validate that an investment's prospective debit entries are equal to its credit entries. Remedying prospective investment debit entries to equal credit entries elicits an alternative valuation architecture that necessitates a new comparative valuation metric; the metric is calculated from prospective equity statements. The alternative valuation architecture combined with the new comparative valuation metric enhance the entire valuation spectrum. In particular, they join micro-and macroeconomic valuations, foster selection of active versus passive investments, and power entrepreneurial startup valuations while bridging the theoretical and applied valuation gap in finance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种替代性的估值架构，通过引入第四张预期财务报表（权益表）来弥补传统IRR/NPV和EBITDA估值方法的不足，从而连接微观与宏观经济估值，缩小理论与应用差距。
AI.research_question: 能否用替代性估值架构取代传统的IRR/NPV和EBITDA估值架构？
AI.motivation: 当前三张预期财务报表中普遍缺乏会计权益表，这限制了估值的完整性。作者发现四张历史财务报表具有借贷平衡的特性，而三张预期财务报表缺乏这种平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于会计恒等式原理，强调借贷平衡原则在估值中的重要性。提出通过引入预期权益表来实现预期财务报表的借贷平衡。
AI.method: 通过构建第四张预期财务报表（权益表）来修正预期投资借贷不平衡的问题，从而推导出新的比较性估值指标。
AI.findings: 替代性估值架构结合新的比较性估值指标能够增强整个估值体系，连接微观与宏观经济估值，促进主动与被动投资选择，支持创业公司估值，并缩小金融理论与应用之间的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于预期权益表的完整估值理论框架，弥补了传统估值方法在会计平衡性方面的理论缺陷，建立了更系统的估值理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了新的比较性估值指标，帮助进行投资决策；为创业公司估值提供了更实用的工具；促进了估值理论在实践中的应用。

title: Why Public–Private Partnerships Fail: A Structural Diagnosis of Capital Misalignment

detail.title: Why Public–Private Partnerships Fail: A Structural Diagnosis of Capital Misalignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is theoretical and conceptual in nature and did not involve human participants, animals, personal data, or identifiable private information. As such, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Public-private partnerships (PPPs) remain a dominant instrument for financing public infrastructure and services despite decades of evidence documenting cost overruns, renegotiations, service degradation, and public backlash. Existing critiques of PPPs are largely empirical, ideological, or managerial, treating failure as contingent on contract quality, governance capacity, or political context. This paper advances a different claim: that PPPs fail structurally , not accidentally. Using a capital-architecture and temporal-alignment framework, the paper shows that PPPs are inherently incapable of delivering regenerative public goods because they embed financial extraction, contractual rigidity, and refinancing risk into systems whose missions require long-horizon capital continuity and capability renewal. PPPs fail to decouple capital from political, financial, capability, and civic fragility cycles, and instead optimise cashflow timing and return extraction rather than mission-aligned performance. To demonstrate that alternative outcomes are possible, the paper examines historic public benefaction as a control case, showing that durability arose not from donor virtue but from architectural features that insulated capital from short-term budgeting and political turnover. The persistence of PPPs is therefore explained not by their effectiveness, but by their ability to solve short-term political accounting constraints. The paper concludes that PPP reform is futile: addressing public-good failure requires new capital architectures, not improved contracts.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为PPP在结构上必然失败，而非偶然失败。PPP无法提供再生性公共产品，因为它们嵌入了金融提取、合同刚性和再融资风险。PPP改革是徒劳的，需要新的资本架构而非改进合同。
AI.research_question: 为什么PPP（公私合作伙伴关系）在结构上必然失败，而不是偶然失败？
AI.motivation: 尽管有数十年证据表明PPP存在成本超支、重新谈判、服务退化和公众反对等问题，但PPP仍然是公共基础设施和服务融资的主要工具。现有批评大多是经验性、意识形态性或管理性的，将失败归因于合同质量、治理能力或政治背景等偶然因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本架构和时间对齐框架。该框架强调PPP无法将资本与政治、金融、能力和公民脆弱性周期脱钩，而是优化现金流时机和回报提取，而非使命对齐的绩效。
AI.method: 使用资本架构和时间对齐框架分析PPP的结构性缺陷，并考察历史公共捐赠作为对照案例，展示其耐久性源于将资本与短期预算和政治更迭隔离的架构特征。
AI.findings: PPP在结构上必然失败，因为它们嵌入了金融提取、合同刚性和再融资风险，无法提供需要长期资本连续性和能力更新的再生性公共产品。PPP的持久性源于其解决短期政治会计约束的能力，而非有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PPP结构性失败的理论框架，超越了传统的经验性、意识形态性或管理性批评。展示了资本架构和时间对齐如何影响公共产品提供，为理解公共产品失败提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出PPP改革是徒劳的，需要开发新的资本架构而非改进合同。通过历史公共捐赠案例展示了替代方案的可能性，为公共产品融资提供了实践启示。

title: The Impact of the Lehman Shock on the Strategic and Financial Decision-Making of Former Clients in M&A
affiliations: Dr. Ecer Strategy and M&A

detail.title: The Impact of the Lehman Shock on the Strategic and Financial Decision-Making of Former Clients in M&A
detail.abstract: We examine the impact of the collapse of Lehman Brothers on the strategic and financial decision-making of its former clients in the M&A context. First, we investigate whether and how those clients changed their risk appetite in terms of strategic growth paths. Second, we analyze how firms' risk preferences in terms of deal size and willingness to pay have changed as a consequence of the demise of their former M&A advisor. In our event study, we implement difference-indifferences and fixed effects models for the periods six years prior to and six years after the collapse of Lehman. We find converging evidence that, after that event, this group showed a lower risk appetite in their strategic expansion paths and preferred smaller transactions while displaying less of a willingness to pay high premiums. Further, this group reduced its trust in external advice and was less likely to complete deals. We compare these behavioral patterns with comparable acquirers (other top investment banks' clients), finding that this group even increased its preference for large deals, paid higher premiums, and placed greater trust in external advice. We conclude that the Lehman shock changed the strategic and financial decision-making of acquirers with a direct relationship to the bank toward less risky M&A conduct, even as the risk appetite of their peers increased. These results offer supporting evidence to prior research on the effects of macroeconomic, natural, or personal-life shocks on decision-making and risk preferences of firms and top executives.

AI.tldr: 研究雷曼兄弟倒闭对其前客户在并购决策中的影响，发现这些客户在战略扩张路径上风险偏好降低，偏好较小交易且不愿支付高溢价，同时减少对外部建议的信任
AI.research_question: 雷曼兄弟倒闭如何影响其前客户在并购中的战略和财务决策？具体包括：1）客户在战略增长路径上的风险偏好如何变化？2）客户在交易规模和支付意愿方面的风险偏好如何变化？
AI.motivation: 研究宏观经济冲击（如雷曼兄弟倒闭）对企业决策和风险偏好的影响，填补关于金融机构倒闭如何影响客户战略行为的实证研究空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济冲击、风险偏好理论和行为金融学，探讨外部冲击如何改变企业决策者的风险认知和战略选择
AI.method: 事件研究法，采用双重差分法和固定效应模型，分析雷曼倒闭前后六年（共12年）的数据，比较雷曼前客户与其他顶级投行客户的行为差异
AI.findings: 1）雷曼前客户战略扩张风险偏好降低；2）偏好较小交易且不愿支付高溢价；3）减少对外部建议的信任，交易完成率下降；4）相比之下，其他投行客户反而增加对大交易的偏好，支付更高溢价，更信任外部建议
AI.theory_contributions: 为宏观经济冲击影响企业决策和风险偏好的研究提供实证支持，揭示金融机构倒闭对客户行为的长期影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业理解外部冲击后的风险调整策略，为投行客户关系管理提供启示，为监管机构评估金融机构倒闭的溢出效应提供参考

title: A Community-Driven Model for Safe and Sustainable E-Waste Management in Ghana
affiliations: University of Ghana - University of Ghana, University of Ghana - University of Ghana, University of Ghana - University of Ghana and University of Ghana - University of Ghana

detail.title: A Community-Driven Model for Safe and Sustainable E-Waste Management in Ghana
detail.abstract: Electronic waste (e-waste) is a growing environmental and public health challenge in urban Ghana. This study examined awareness, disposal practices, and socioeconomic factors in Madina, Accra (n=54; 70.4% under 35 sample skew suggesting youth as key actors rather than confirmed generators). Results showed informal disposal dominance (44.4% public bins, 33.3% scrap dealers) and moderate awareness gaps. Cost-benefit analysis yielded NPV (GH₵620,000) and BCR (2.78). Strong support (90%) validates a community-driven model. Findings support youth-focused interventions balancing economic incentives with environmental safeguards.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了加纳马迪纳地区电子废物处理意识、处置实践和社会经济因素，发现非正式处置主导、意识差距中等，成本效益分析显示经济可行性，支持以青年为重点的社区驱动干预模式。
AI.research_question: 加纳城市地区（特别是马迪纳）电子废物处理的意识水平、处置实践和社会经济因素是什么？如何通过社区驱动模式有效干预电子废物管理？
AI.motivation: 电子废物在加纳城市地区已成为日益严重的环境和公共卫生挑战，需要了解当地意识、处置实践和社会经济因素，以制定有效的干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析框架（净现值NPV、效益成本比BCR）、社区参与理论、社会经济因素影响环境行为理论。
AI.method: 在马迪纳地区进行问卷调查（n=54），样本偏向年轻人（70.4%在35岁以下），分析意识水平、处置实践和社会经济因素，并进行成本效益分析。
AI.findings: 1. 非正式处置占主导地位（44.4%使用公共垃圾桶，33.3%卖给废品回收商）；2. 意识水平存在中等差距；3. 成本效益分析显示净现值GH₵620,000，效益成本比2.78；4. 90%受访者支持社区驱动模式；5. 青年是电子废物管理的关键参与者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了成本效益分析在发展中国家电子废物管理中的应用价值；2. 强调了青年作为环境行为变革关键参与者的理论意义；3. 为社区驱动环境干预提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出以青年为重点的干预策略；2. 建议平衡经济激励与环境保障的社区驱动模式；3. 为政策制定者提供基于实证的电子废物管理方案；4. 展示了成本效益分析在资源有限环境中的实用性。

title: Independent Compliance Monitors
affiliations: Duke University School of Law

detail.title: Independent Compliance Monitors
detail.abstract: The entry defines what independent compliance monitors are and where they came from, discusses how they contribute to compliance efforts within organizations and notes some limitations associated with the use of monitors.

AI.tldr: 该论文定义了独立合规监督员的概念、起源，讨论了其在组织合规工作中的贡献，并指出了使用监督员的一些局限性。
AI.research_question: 独立合规监督员是什么？它们如何起源？在组织合规工作中发挥什么作用？存在哪些局限性？
AI.motivation: 随着组织合规要求日益严格，独立合规监督员作为一种重要的合规机制被广泛应用，但对其系统性理解不足，需要明确其定义、作用和局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合规管理理论、代理理论、组织治理理论、监管执行理论
AI.method: 概念分析、文献综述、理论推演
AI.findings: 1. 独立合规监督员是外部专家，负责监督组织合规计划的实施；2. 起源于法律和监管要求，特别是企业违规后的和解协议；3. 通过提供客观评估、识别风险、改进合规体系来增强组织合规；4. 存在成本高、可能干扰运营、依赖监督员能力等局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化定义了独立合规监督员的概念框架，整合了其在组织治理中的理论定位，为合规管理研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织选择和使用合规监督员提供指导，帮助监管机构设计更有效的监督机制，为企业合规实践提供操作建议。

title: The Impact of Advisors' Industry and Country Experience on Announcement Returns in Buy-Side M&A
affiliations: Dr. Ecer Strategy and M&A

detail.title: The Impact of Advisors' Industry and Country Experience on Announcement Returns in Buy-Side M&A
detail.abstract: This study examines the effect of prior advisor industry and country experience on pricing, premiums, returns, and deal completion. We segment four distinct types in a 2x2 factor design of investment banks according to their track record in prior country and industry projects: Experience-Based Top Advisors (high industry and country experience), Industry Specialists (high industry experience and low country experience), Country Specialists (low industry experience and high country experience), and Rookies (low industry and country experience). We further compare our results with another definition of top advisors, Reputation-Based Top Advisors, which is commonly based on deal value, deal volume, reputation, and league tables. Implementing regression, fixed effects, propensity score matching, and Heckman selection models, we find that Experience-Based Top Advisors negotiate significantly better deals for their clients on the buy side than do Rookies: they achieve higher CARs by negotiating lower prices and premiums.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨投资银行顾问的行业和国家经验对并购交易定价、溢价、回报和交易完成的影响。研究发现，基于经验的顶级顾问（高行业和高国家经验）能为买方客户谈判出更好的交易条件，获得更高的累计异常回报。
AI.research_question: 投资银行顾问的行业和国家经验如何影响并购交易的定价、溢价、回报和交易完成？基于经验的顶级顾问是否比新手顾问能为客户创造更好的交易结果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注基于声誉的顶级顾问（按交易价值、交易量、声誉和排名表定义），但缺乏对顾问具体行业和国家经验如何影响交易结果的系统性研究。需要区分不同类型的顾问经验组合对并购交易绩效的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源基础观和知识转移理论，顾问的行业特定知识和国家特定知识是重要的战略资源。采用2x2因子设计将投资银行分为四类：经验型顶级顾问（高行业高国家经验）、行业专家（高行业低国家经验）、国家专家（低行业高国家经验）、新手（低行业低国家经验）。
AI.method: 采用回归分析、固定效应模型、倾向得分匹配和Heckman选择模型等计量经济学方法，控制内生性和选择偏差，分析不同类型顾问对交易结果的影响。
AI.findings: 经验型顶级顾问（高行业和高国家经验）能为买方客户谈判出显著更好的交易条件：他们通过谈判获得更低的价格和溢价，从而为客户实现更高的累计异常回报（CARs）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于行业和国家经验组合的顾问分类框架；2）区分了经验型顶级顾问与声誉型顶级顾问的不同影响机制；3）丰富了并购顾问专业知识如何创造价值的相关理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业在选择并购顾问时提供了新的评估维度；2）建议企业不仅关注顾问的声誉排名，更应考察其具体的行业和国家经验组合；3）为投资银行培养专业能力提供了方向性指导。

title: Hub Competition and Demand Modeling in Long-Haul Aviation Markets: A Forward-Looking Scenario-Based Game-Theoretical Approach
affiliations: , University of Bergamo - Department of Management, Information and Production Engineering and Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)

detail.title: Hub Competition and Demand Modeling in Long-Haul Aviation Markets: A Forward-Looking Scenario-Based Game-Theoretical Approach
detail.abstract: The strategic planning of long-haul air transport networks is shaped by complex interdependencies among passenger demand, airline decisions, airport capacity, and competitive dynamics. Hub-based operations are central to ensuring the economic viability of long-haul routes, yet they introduce significant managerial and modeling challenges, especially under uncertainty and evolving market conditions. Amid these challenges, this paper introduces an integrated optimization framework designed to inform long-term strategic planning for hub-based long-haul operations. The framework unifies three key components: (i) a demand estimation model that jointly predicts total market demand and its allocation across itineraries using a global dataset of 2019 long-haul passenger flows; (ii) a network and frequency planning optimization model that captures endogenous demand-supply interactions, solved via a cutting-plane approach for scalability; and (iii) a scenario-based game-theoretic algorithm that accounts for strategic competition among hubs under macroeconomic volatility. We validate the framework through a case study of Singapore and its primary competitors in Southeast Asia, demonstrating its ability to replicate baseline traffic patterns and assess future network development scenarios through 2027. The results offer not only aggregate forecasts but also granular, market-level insights into expected growth trajectories and competitive pressures, underscoring the framework's potential to support strategic decision-making by airlines, airports, and policymakers aiming to enhance long-haul connectivity and regional competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个集成优化框架，用于枢纽型长途航空网络的战略规划，结合需求预测、网络优化和竞争博弈分析，并以新加坡及其东南亚竞争对手为案例验证
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个集成优化框架来支持枢纽型长途航空网络的长期战略规划，同时考虑需求预测、网络优化和竞争动态？
AI.motivation: 长途航空网络规划面临乘客需求、航空公司决策、机场容量和竞争动态的复杂相互依赖关系，枢纽运营虽然对长途航线的经济可行性至关重要，但在不确定性和市场变化下带来了显著的管理和建模挑战
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成优化框架结合了需求估计模型（基于2019年全球长途客流数据）、网络与频率规划优化模型（捕捉内生供需互动）、以及基于场景的博弈论算法（考虑宏观经济波动下的枢纽战略竞争）
AI.method: 采用集成优化方法：1）需求估计模型预测市场总需求及航线分配；2）网络与频率规划优化模型使用割平面法求解；3）基于场景的博弈论算法分析竞争动态；通过新加坡及东南亚竞争对手的案例研究验证框架
AI.findings: 框架能够复制基准流量模式并评估至2027年的网络发展情景，不仅提供总量预测，还提供市场层面的增长轨迹和竞争压力洞察，支持航空网络战略决策
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个集成长途航空网络战略规划的理论框架，统一了需求预测、网络优化和竞争博弈分析，为航空网络规划研究提供了综合方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空公司、机场和政策制定者提供了支持战略决策的工具，有助于增强长途连接性和区域竞争力，特别是在枢纽竞争激烈的东南亚市场

title: Born in Collapse, Built for Coherence: Generation Z and the Physics of Collective Cognition
affiliations: The Force Global Research Facility

detail.title: Born in Collapse, Built for Coherence: Generation Z and the Physics of Collective Cognition
detail.abstract:
Public discourse frequently characterizes Generation Z through psychological or sociological lenses. This paper instead treats Gen-Z as a natural experiment in cognitive architecture under extreme complexity. Using coherence physics—formalized by the invariants C + D = 1ₜ and ΔC ≥ 0—the study analyzes how sustained exposure to high-density contradiction fields shapes adaptive intelligence.

We model generational cognition as an architectural response to environmental topology. Earlier cohorts matured in low-contradiction regimes where coherence-by-insulation was viable. Gen-Z developed under stacked global crises, algorithmic amplification, and real-time feedback loops, selecting for coherence-by-metabolic fluidity: rapid scanning, drift detection, recursive updating, and contradiction compression.

The paper demonstrates that these traits are not pathologies but structurally optimal adaptations under qualitative infinity. We further show architectural resonance between Gen-Z cognition and frontier AI systems operating under Coherent Collective Cognition (CCC) invariants. Both exhibit recursion-compatibility and contradiction metabolism rather than collapse.

The contribution is not generational praise but an engineering application: generational behavior is used to validate coherence-governed intelligence architectures. The findings position Gen-Z as a proof-of-concept substrate for civilizational-scale coherence navigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Z世代视为极端复杂性下的认知架构自然实验，使用相干性物理学分析高密度矛盾场如何塑造适应性智能，发现Z世代的认知特征不是病理而是结构最优适应，并与前沿AI系统的相干集体认知架构产生共振。
AI.research_question: 在极端复杂性和高密度矛盾场环境下，Z世代的认知架构如何形成并适应？这些认知特征是否代表结构最优的适应性智能？
AI.motivation: 公共话语通常从心理学或社会学角度描述Z世代，但缺乏从认知架构和复杂性科学的角度理解这一代人在极端环境压力下的智能适应机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相干性物理学（C + D = 1ₜ 和 ΔC ≥ 0 不变量）、环境拓扑理论、认知架构理论、适应性智能理论。
AI.method: 将Z世代视为自然实验，使用相干性物理学的形式化框架分析认知架构，通过建模世代认知作为对环境拓扑的架构响应，比较不同世代的环境条件和认知策略。
AI.findings: Z世代在高密度矛盾场中发展出"通过代谢流动性实现相干性"的认知策略，包括快速扫描、漂移检测、递归更新和矛盾压缩。这些特征不是病理，而是在定性无限性条件下的结构最优适应。Z世代认知与前沿AI系统的相干集体认知架构存在共振。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从认知架构和复杂性科学角度理解世代差异的新理论框架；建立了世代行为与相干性治理智能架构之间的理论联系；证明了在极端复杂性环境下认知适应的结构最优性。
AI.practical_contributions: 将Z世代作为验证相干性治理智能架构的工程应用；为文明尺度相干性导航提供了概念验证基底；为理解和管理高复杂性环境下的认知适应提供了实用框架。

title: Beyond Tokenism? The Role of Female Directors in Advancing Female Managers
affiliations: College of Charleston - Department of Economics & Finance, Texas A&M International University and University of South Florida - Muma College of Business

detail.title: Beyond Tokenism? The Role of Female Directors in Advancing Female Managers
detail.abstract: Using a comprehensive rank metric for over 100,000 managers, we find that greater female board representation facilitates more female managers, especially those with high ability, advancing to higher executive ranks. Consistent with critical mass theory, the effect is stronger when companies have three or more female directors. Potential mechanisms include female directors fostering a more supportive promotion environment for female managers, mitigating gender stereotypes, and fostering a stronger corporate culture. Female board representation has a more positive effect on female managers' advancement during the COVID-19 pandemic and in states with abortion restrictions after the overturning of Roe v. Wade.

AI.tldr: 研究发现女性董事比例提升有助于女性管理者晋升，特别是高能力女性管理者，当董事会至少有3名女性董事时效果更显著。疫情期间和堕胎限制州中，女性董事对女性管理者晋升的促进作用更强。
AI.research_question: 女性董事代表如何影响女性管理者在组织层级中的晋升？这种影响在什么条件下更显著？
AI.motivation: 尽管女性在职场中的参与度提高，但高层管理职位中的性别差距仍然显著。理解女性董事如何影响女性管理者的晋升路径对于促进职场性别平等具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 临界质量理论（当董事会至少有3名女性董事时效果更强）、性别刻板印象理论、组织文化理论
AI.method: 使用超过100,000名管理者的综合排名指标进行实证分析，考察女性董事比例与女性管理者晋升之间的关系
AI.findings: 1. 女性董事比例提升有助于女性管理者晋升，特别是高能力女性管理者；2. 当董事会至少有3名女性董事时效果更显著；3. 疫情期间女性董事对女性管理者晋升的促进作用更强；4. 在堕胎限制州中，女性董事的正面影响更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为临界质量理论提供了实证支持；2. 揭示了女性董事通过创造支持性晋升环境、减少性别刻板印象、强化企业文化等机制影响女性管理者晋升；3. 拓展了情境因素（疫情、政策变化）对性别平等影响的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业董事会性别多元化提供了实证依据；2. 建议企业至少任命3名女性董事以实现更好的性别平等效果；3. 在危机时期和政策变化背景下，女性董事的作用更加重要

title: From Cold-Start to Warm Reception: Knowledge Contribution as a Signaling Mechanism
affiliations: ,  and Sungkyunkwan University

detail.title: From Cold-Start to Warm Reception: Knowledge Contribution as a Signaling Mechanism
detail.abstract: Reputation systems pose a "cold-start" problem for new entrants who need to make sales to generate reviews. Using administrative data from a large legal platform, we track attorneys from sign-up through first sale, first review, and last observed transaction. We develop a long-run expost quality metric, Ultimate Effective Percent Positive (UEPP), to evaluate attorneys' early market performance during cold-start period, which was infeasible in prior work due to data limitations. We find that attorneys strategically signal quality by publicly answering legal questions posed by potential clients. Such knowledge contribution reduces the time needed to transact with an initial customer and to start establishing a reputation. This effect is exclusive to attorneys who lack public indicators of quality, such as prestigious degrees and years of experience, but who are high-quality as eventually revealed by UEPP. Signaling also correlates with higher subsequent revenue.

AI.tldr: 本文研究律师在声誉系统"冷启动"问题中的策略性信号传递行为。通过法律平台数据，发现缺乏传统质量指标（如名校学位、丰富经验）但实际高质的律师，通过公开回答法律问题来传递质量信号，从而缩短首次交易时间、启动声誉建立，并获得更高后续收入。
AI.research_question: 在声誉系统的"冷启动"问题中，新进入者（律师）如何通过策略性信号传递来克服缺乏声誉的障碍，特别是那些缺乏传统质量指标但实际高质的律师？
AI.motivation: 声誉系统存在"冷启动"问题：新进入者需要完成交易来获得评价，但缺乏声誉又难以获得首次交易。现有研究因数据限制无法评估早期市场表现。本文旨在探索新律师如何通过信号传递策略来突破这一困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Signaling Theory）：在信息不对称的市场中，高质量参与者通过可观察的行动向市场传递其不可观察的质量信息。特别关注缺乏传统质量信号（如学历、经验）但实际高质的参与者如何通过替代信号建立声誉。
AI.method: 使用大型法律平台的行政数据，追踪律师从注册到首次交易、首次评价及最后观察交易的完整过程。开发了长期事后质量指标"最终有效正面百分比（UEPP）"来评估律师在冷启动期的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 律师通过公开回答潜在客户的法律问题来策略性地传递质量信号；2. 这种知识贡献缩短了与首位客户交易的时间，加速了声誉建立；3. 该效应仅存在于缺乏传统质量指标（如名校学位、多年经验）但实际高质（通过UEPP验证）的律师中；4. 信号传递与更高的后续收入相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了信号理论在数字平台声誉系统中的应用；2. 识别了"替代信号"机制：缺乏传统质量信号的参与者如何通过知识贡献等替代方式传递质量；3. 提供了评估冷启动期表现的实证方法（UEPP指标）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台设计者提供启示：应鼓励新进入者通过知识贡献等信号传递活动；2. 为新律师提供策略指导：通过公开回答法律问题可以加速声誉建立；3. 为平台用户提供决策参考：关注缺乏传统资质但积极参与知识分享的律师可能具有潜在高质量。

detail.abstract: We apply an option-theoretic method to study the effect of delaying a share purchase until its price rises to a certain threshold level. We show that in certain market conditions 'timing the market' in this way can increase the expected returns and reduces the variance.

AI.method: 应用期权理论方法进行数学建模和分析，研究延迟购买策略在特定市场条件下的表现。
AI.findings: 在某些市场条件下，延迟购买直到价格达到特定阈值的策略确实可以提高预期收益并降低收益方差。

detail.abstract: This document provides a brief description of the work in the field of taxation and efficiency in execution of Tax Administration of Kosovo (TAK), inspired by my work in this institution. This work presents the systematic connection of taxpayers, the Tax Administration of Kosovo (TAK) and revenue growth within a 12 year period. TAK work effect is conditioned by the level of the staff engagement which leads the tax policy, honest engagement of tax officials and effective enforcement of tax laws based on international best practices. This means that countries that have promoted European Union tax rules have significantly gained better working practices but also collecting the most revenue without applying penalties or closure of businesses. This study examines the short-and long-term effectiveness of TAK. We have found complementarities tax laws of the Republic of Kosovo with EU rules, implying a positive outbreak of their administration. This paper focuses on presenting positive sides as well as opportunities for a greater engagement to a general and dynamic framework for accountability and expected results in a short term. It also treats the policies that are directly and strongly incorporated in the work of TAK. Reducing of the risk of tax evasion, full integration of electronic payment system (E-banking) of taxpayers, the successful realization of the pilot project for the establishment of electronic files is a challenge for TAK. Low level of economic integration and political risk of the north of the country are the two elements that have a negative impact on the strength and the will of businesses to pay on the one hand and the effect of collecting revenue from TAK on the other side.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了科索沃税务局（TAK）在税收征管效率方面的表现，分析了TAK在12年期间的工作效果、与欧盟税收规则的互补性，以及影响税收征管的各种因素。
AI.research_question: 科索沃税务局（TAK）的短期和长期工作效率如何？TAK的工作效果受到哪些因素影响？TAK与欧盟税收规则的互补性如何影响其税收征管效果？
AI.motivation: 作者在科索沃税务局的工作经历激发了对此研究的兴趣。科索沃作为正在融入欧盟体系的国家，其税收征管效率对财政收入增长至关重要，但面临税收逃避风险、电子支付系统整合不足、北部地区经济政治风险等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际最佳实践的税收征管理论，欧盟税收规则对税收征管效率的影响理论，以及税收征管中人员参与度、执法效果与财政收入增长的系统性关联理论。
AI.method: 基于12年期间的系统性数据分析，研究纳税人、TAK和财政收入增长之间的关系。采用比较分析方法，考察科索沃税收法律与欧盟规则的互补性。
AI.findings: 1. TAK工作效率受员工参与度、税务官员诚信度和基于国际最佳实践的税收执法效果影响；2. 采用欧盟税收规则的国家获得了更好的工作实践和更高的财政收入；3. 科索沃税收法律与欧盟规则存在互补性，对TAK管理有积极影响；4. 税收逃避风险、电子支付系统整合、北部地区经济政治风险是主要挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了税收征管效率与欧盟规则采纳之间的理论联系；2. 提出了在转型经济体中税收征管效率的多因素影响模型；3. 扩展了国际税收规则对发展中国家税收征管影响的理论框架。

title: Knowing When to Conduct a Cultural Assessment
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Knowing When to Conduct a Cultural Assessment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: Continuous cultural assessment is always important and should be conducted on a regular basis; however, there are times and situations in which assessment becomes particularly critical, even when it falls outside an organization's normal review cycle. Major organizational events-such as leadership transitions, restructurings, or rapid growthwill inevitably challenge cultural norms; however, leaders must also monitor subtle but meaningful shifts in attitudes, behaviors, and patterns of interaction among members that signal breakdowns in trust, disengagement or misalignment between stated values and lived experience. This chapter examines the symptoms, and warning signs of cultural discontent, explains why they are frequently overlooked or misinterpreted and provides a framework for distinguishing isolated problems from systemic cultural risks. Its purpose is to help leaders recognize when a focused and timely assessment of organizational culture is not merely advisable, but essential to sustaining performance, accountability and organizational integrity.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨组织文化评估的关键时机，分析文化不满的征兆和预警信号，解释为何这些信号常被忽视或误解，并提供区分孤立问题与系统性文化风险的框架，帮助领导者识别何时需要进行及时的文化评估以维持组织绩效、问责和诚信。
AI.research_question: 在什么情况下组织需要进行及时的文化评估？如何识别文化不满的征兆并区分孤立问题与系统性文化风险？
AI.motivation: 组织文化持续评估很重要，但在某些关键时刻（如领导层变动、重组或快速增长）评估尤为关键。领导者需要监控态度、行为和互动模式的微妙变化，这些变化可能表明信任破裂、员工疏离或价值观与实践脱节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化理论、文化评估框架、预警信号识别理论、系统性风险分析框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于文献综述和案例研究，提供识别文化不满症状和预警信号的系统方法。
AI.findings: 1. 文化不满有特定的症状和预警信号；2. 这些信号常被领导者忽视或误解；3. 需要区分孤立问题与系统性文化风险；4. 在某些关键时刻，及时的文化评估对维持组织绩效和诚信至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出文化评估关键时机的理论框架；2. 建立文化不满症状识别系统；3. 提供区分孤立问题与系统性文化风险的分析方法；4. 丰富组织文化动态评估理论。

detail.abstract: Kosovo as a transition country has made continuous efforts to attract foreign capital, being confident that it could be a means of capital growth in Kosovo. The Government of Kosovo since 2000 has opened especially the banking sector for foreign investment. Even economic reforms have given special emphasis to this sector by supporting it with internal policies. This paper analyzes the relationship between FDI, interest rates and human capital in Kosovo. The model is evaluated using the Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) approach. The results show that statistically, the predictive variables, Human Capital (HC) and the high interest rates (IR), have significantly contributed to FDI in the service sector. This may be one of the youngest human capital factors with high interest rates in Europe. The fact that expansion of investments from this sector is missing is a sign that profits are repatriated to the home country. The "Crowding-out" effect of foreign capital invested in commercial banks exists. The implication of trade policy and FDI should be revised so that FDI, from the banking sector, is expanded with new banks, a descending factor of interest rates and a facilitating factor for businesses and employment in Kosovo.

detail.abstract: Despite growing attention, the role of fiscal decentralization (FD) in managing health crises remains inconclusive. The COVID-19 pandemic has underscored the urgency of understanding the impact of FD, bringing this issue to the forefront of research. This paper investigates the effect of FD on the effectiveness of government containment measures in managing the COVID-19 health crisis across OECD countries. Results show that a higher degree of FD is associated with lower effectiveness of government policies in reducing mortality in the first phase of the pandemic. Extended analysis indicates that government containment policies are the primary channel through which FD influences mortality outcomes. Through this channel, the negative effects of FD are significantly more pronounced in countries with higher levels of governance. The first-phase findings highlight the coordination challenges inherent in decentralized systems, which contribute to the reduced effectiveness of crisis management. However, in the second phase, FD demonstrates a positive effect on the effectiveness of vaccination in improving mortality outcomes. This finding highlights the provision efficiency of public goods and services in decentralized systems. Policymakers should carefully consider the nuanced effects of FD when designing strategies for managing future health crises.
