title: Authoritarian Civic Traps: Repression, Civic Capacity, and Political Participation after the Arab Spring
affiliations: University of South Brittany

detail.title: Authoritarian Civic Traps: Repression, Civic Capacity, and Political Participation after the Arab Spring
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a dynamic, micro-founded model of collective action under authoritarian legacies, where regime persistence results not from weak democratic preferences but from repression-induced erosion of civic capacity. Participation is shaped by beliefs, trust, and repression risk, while civic capacity develops endogenously via learning, peer effects, and institutional decay. The model predicts that repression undermines mobilization structurally over time. Using Arab Barometer data from five countries across two waves, the findings show that civic capacity-not democratic preference-is the primary driver of non-electoral political engagement, which declines significantly post-Arab Spring. These results support the concept of an authoritarian civic trap, where democratic aspirations remain, but mobilization capacity is systematically weakened.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个关于威权遗产下集体行动的动态微观基础模型，认为政权持续不是因为民主偏好弱，而是因为镇压导致公民能力侵蚀。参与受信念、信任和镇压风险影响，公民能力通过学习、同伴效应和制度衰退内生发展。模型预测镇压会随时间结构性削弱动员能力。使用阿拉伯晴雨表数据发现，公民能力（而非民主偏好）是非选举政治参与的主要驱动因素，且在阿拉伯之春后显著下降，支持"威权公民陷阱"概念。
AI.research_question: 在威权遗产背景下，是什么因素驱动或抑制集体行动和政治参与？特别是，政权持续是由于民主偏好薄弱，还是由于镇压导致的公民能力侵蚀？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为威权政权持续是因为民众缺乏民主偏好，但作者认为需要更细致地理解镇压如何通过侵蚀公民能力来结构性削弱动员，即使民主愿望仍然存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态微观基础集体行动模型，强调信念、信任和镇压风险对参与决策的影响；公民能力内生发展理论，通过学习、同伴效应和制度衰退机制；威权公民陷阱概念。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建动态微观基础模型；实证分析：使用阿拉伯晴雨表数据，涵盖五个国家两个波次（阿拉伯之春前后）的调查数据。
AI.findings: 1. 公民能力（而非民主偏好）是非选举政治参与的主要驱动因素；2. 阿拉伯之春后非选举政治参与显著下降；3. 实证结果支持威权公民陷阱概念，即民主愿望仍在，但动员能力被系统性削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个动态微观基础模型，解释镇压如何随时间结构性削弱动员能力；2. 发展了公民能力内生发展理论；3. 提出了"威权公民陷阱"概念框架，区分民主偏好和动员能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解威权政权持续性提供了新视角；2. 对民主转型和政策干预有启示意义，强调需要重建公民能力而不仅仅是改变态度；3. 对阿拉伯地区政治动态提供了实证见解。

title: From Security to Sustainability: The BES Determinants of Italian Regional GDP
affiliations: University of Catania, Unicusano University, Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro, Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro and Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l.

detail.title: From Security to Sustainability: The BES Determinants of Italian Regional GDP
detail.abstract: This paper explores the link between economic performance and multidimensional well-being in the Italian context using a combination of the ISTAT BES approach (Benessere Equo e Sostenibile) and machine learning and clustering analysis. On the basis of a dataset of 19 Italian regions and the Autonomous Provinces of Trento and Bolzano from 2012 to 2023, it will be examined how the three BES components-Benessere (B), Equità (E), and Sostenibilità (S)-are intertwined with the Gross Domestic Product of the regions. Regarding the Benessere (B) component of well-being, the Gross Domestic Product will be analyzed using a regression approach of the K-Nearest Neighbors type to reveal the complex linkages between health outcomes, education outcomes, working conditions, social participation, and economic performance. The clustering of the B indicators and the Gross Domestic Product will be done using Hierarchical Clustering analysis to identify homogeneous territories characterized by different levels of quality of life and economic prosperity. Regarding the Equità (E) component of well-being, the regression analysis will be done using the Boosting algorithm to model the linkages between the Gross Domestic Product and the indicators of income distribution, poverty, material deprivation, and inclusion in the labor market. Boosting regression analysis will be particularly useful for this purpose since it models the complex interactions and thresholds of social and economic inequalities. Hierarchical Clustering analysis will be applied to identify the territories characterized by different levels of equity and economic growth. Regarding the Sostenibilità (S) component of well-being, the Gross Domestic Product will be modeled using Boosting regression analysis to reveal the very complex linkages between the economic performance of the territories and the indicators of environmental quality, risk of climate change, innovation outcomes, and the quality of public services. For this purpose, the analysis will use the Random Forest algorithm to identify the territories characterized by different levels of sustainability and economic performance. The analysis will show that the BES approach provides a very useful framework to identify the very different levels of linkages between the economic performance of the territories and the outcomes of the BES approach. The analysis will provide evidence that the BES approach is a very useful framework for the analysis of the linkages between the economic performance of the territories and the outcomes of the BES approach.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ISTAT BES框架结合机器学习方法，分析意大利19个地区2012-2023年间经济表现与多维福祉（福祉、公平、可持续性）之间的复杂关系。
AI.research_question: 意大利各地区经济表现（GDP）与多维福祉（BES框架下的福祉、公平、可持续性三个维度）之间存在怎样的复杂联系？
AI.motivation: 传统经济指标如GDP无法全面衡量社会福祉，需要采用多维度的福祉评估框架（BES）来更全面地理解经济发展与生活质量、社会公平、环境可持续性之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: ISTAT BES（公平与可持续福祉）框架，包含三个核心维度：福祉（Benessere）、公平（Equità）、可持续性（Sostenibilità）。该框架超越了传统GDP衡量，提供了更全面的社会发展评估体系。
AI.method:
1. 数据：意大利19个地区和特伦托、博尔扎诺自治省2012-2023年数据
2. 分析方法：K-最近邻回归（福祉维度）、Boosting回归（公平维度）、Boosting回归和随机森林（可持续性维度）
3. 聚类分析：层次聚类分析识别具有相似特征的地域
AI.findings: 分析将显示BES框架能够有效识别经济表现与福祉结果之间不同水平的联系，证明BES框架是分析地域经济表现与福祉结果关系的有效工具。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将机器学习方法应用于BES框架分析，为多维福祉研究提供新的方法论
2. 验证BES框架在分析经济-福祉关系方面的理论价值
3. 揭示不同福祉维度与经济表现之间复杂、非线性的关系模式
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供识别不同福祉水平地域的工具
2. 帮助地方政府制定更有针对性的区域发展政策
3. 为监测和评估区域发展质量提供实用框架
4. 支持意大利各地区在福祉、公平和可持续性方面的差异化政策设计

title: The Plain English Paradox: Regulation and the Structure of 10-K Language
affiliations: , Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Jerusalem School of Business Administration and Bar Ilan University

detail.title: The Plain English Paradox: Regulation and the Structure of 10-K Language
detail.abstract: Do plain-language mandates reduce disclosure complexity, or do they reshape how complexity is produced? Using 177,068 MD&A sections from 1996-2022, we show that disclosure regulation constrains technical compression while inducing substitution toward hierarchical syntactic elaboration, resulting in a net increase in syntactic load. Exploiting the 2010 Plain Writing Act-which tightened plain-language requirements for domestic 10-K filers but not foreign 20-F filers-we implement a dynamic difference-indifferences design. Treated firms exhibit sustained post-2010 increases in elaborative syntax, while dense complexity remains persistently suppressed. This response is heterogeneous: firms with pre-existing syntactic capacity reorganize structure, whereas firms reliant on technical compression layer explanations onto existing jargon. Higher elaborative complexity is associated with longer filing delays, increased price uncertainty and a 1.4% reduction in firm valuation per standard deviation of complexity. Taken together, the results reveal a Plain English Paradox: mandates intended to simplify disclosures alter the form rather than the burden of complexity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，明文规定虽然减少了技术压缩型复杂性，但促使企业转向层次句法扩展，导致句法负担净增加，形成"简明英语悖论"：旨在简化披露的规定改变了复杂性的形式而非负担。
AI.research_question: 明文规定是减少了披露复杂性，还是重塑了复杂性的产生方式？
AI.motivation: 理解监管规定如何影响企业信息披露的复杂性，特别是明文规定是否真正实现了简化披露的目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论、监管效应理论和复杂性理论，探讨监管干预如何改变企业信息披露策略。
AI.method: 使用1996-2022年177,068份MD&A章节，采用动态双重差分设计，利用2010年《简明写作法案》对国内10-K申报者（处理组）和外国20-F申报者（对照组）的不同影响。
AI.findings: 1) 处理组企业在2010年后句法扩展复杂性持续增加，而密集复杂性持续受抑制；2) 企业反应异质：已有句法能力的企业重组结构，依赖技术压缩的企业在现有行话上叠加解释；3) 更高的扩展复杂性与更长的申报延迟、价格不确定性增加以及企业估值每标准差降低1.4%相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"简明英语悖论"概念，揭示了监管规定如何改变而非减少复杂性，深化了对信息披露策略和监管效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供启示：单纯的语言规定可能无法实现简化目标，需要考虑企业应对策略；为投资者提供警示：复杂性形式变化可能影响信息处理和市场反应。

reference: FRB Boston Research Data Report No. 26-1
title: Educational Attainment and Wage Growth in New England:  Evidence from Four Decades of Administrative Wage Records
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and

detail.title: Educational Attainment and Wage Growth in New England:  Evidence from Four Decades of Administrative Wage Records

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB Boston Research Data Report No. 26-1
publicationDetails.journalName: FRB-Boston: Research Department Research Data Reports (Topic)

detail.abstract: Per capita personal income in New England grew from $10,731 to $87,655 during the 1980–2024 period. This increase, the largest among all US census divisions, coincided with significant growth in educational attainment in the region. As of 2024, 53 percent of New England workers aged 25 to 64 held at least a bachelor’s degree, and 23 percent possessed advanced degrees, compared with national averages of 44 percent and 17 percent, respectively. This study provides new insights into the relationship between educational attainment and income growth in New England, examining both individual earnings and broader regional trajectories.

AI.tldr: 新英格兰地区1980-2024年人均收入增长全美最快，与教育水平显著提升密切相关，该研究探讨了教育程度与收入增长的关系。
AI.research_question: 新英格兰地区教育程度提升与个人收入增长之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系如何影响个人收入和区域经济发展轨迹？
AI.motivation: 新英格兰地区在1980-2024年间人均收入增长全美最快，同时教育水平显著高于全国平均水平，需要深入探究教育对收入增长的贡献机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、区域经济发展理论、教育回报理论
AI.method: 基于1980-2024年新英格兰地区与全国数据的比较分析，包括个人收入数据和教育程度统计的实证研究
AI.findings: 新英格兰地区教育程度显著高于全国平均水平（本科53% vs 44%，高级学位23% vs 17%），且与人均收入快速增长（$10,731到$87,655）存在正相关关系
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了人力资本理论在区域经济发展中的应用，揭示了教育程度与收入增长的具体量化关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为新英格兰地区教育政策制定提供依据，为其他地区通过提升教育水平促进经济发展提供参考

title: How Much Does Responsibility Matter in Fairness Measurement?
affiliations: CY Cergy Paris Université, Statistics Norway - Research Department and Statistics Norway - Research Department

detail.title: How Much Does Responsibility Matter in Fairness Measurement?
detail.abstract: Empirical evidence suggests that social acceptance of redistribution depends on whether income differences result from preferences (of which individuals are responsible) or from circumstances. We propose a new empirical method that measures the importance of preferences in the distribution of welfare in the context of tax reforms. We compare two types of Compensating Variation: the standard CV and a new one (CVcirc), which is computed assuming that individuals differ only in circumstances. To obtain these metrics, we first estimate a structural job choice model that allows us to take the preferences/circumstances dyad into account. We then use the estimated parameters to compute our two metrics, leveraging a tax reform and applying a simulation approach à la McFadden (1999). Implementing our method with Norwegian data, we find that both welfare metrics display a very similar distribution, except at the very top of the households’ income distribution, suggesting this is where responsibility matters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法来衡量偏好对福利分配的重要性，通过比较标准补偿变化和仅考虑环境差异的补偿变化，发现除了收入最高的家庭外，两种福利指标分布非常相似。
AI.research_question: 社会对再分配的接受程度如何取决于收入差异是由偏好（个人责任）还是环境造成的？如何衡量偏好在福利分配中的重要性？
AI.motivation: 经验证据表明，社会对再分配的接受程度取决于收入差异是由偏好（个人责任）还是环境造成的。需要开发新的实证方法来衡量偏好在福利分配中的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 补偿变化理论、责任与公平理论、偏好/环境二元框架、结构工作选择模型
AI.method: 提出新实证方法：比较标准补偿变化（CV）和仅考虑环境差异的补偿变化（CVcirc）。首先估计结构工作选择模型以考虑偏好/环境二元关系，然后使用估计参数计算两个指标，利用税收改革并应用McFadden（1999）的模拟方法。
AI.findings: 使用挪威数据实施该方法，发现两种福利指标分布非常相似，除了家庭收入分布的最高端，这表明责任问题主要出现在收入最高的家庭中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了衡量偏好在福利分配中重要性的新实证方法；发展了补偿变化理论的扩展应用；为责任与公平理论提供了新的测量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估税收改革效果的新工具；帮助识别收入差异中责任因素的重要性；为再分配政策的公平性评估提供实证基础。

title: Wage Expectations and Job Search
affiliations: , , University of Copenhagen, ,  and University of Cologne

detail.title: Wage Expectations and Job Search
detail.abstract: In a field experiment with 9,000 Danish job seekers, we study how unemployed workers’ wage expectations affect job search and re-employment. In our survey, we generate exogenous variation in respondents' wage expectations by informing a random half of them about re-employment wages of comparable workers. The intervention increases job-finding as measured in administrative data for both initially optimistic and initially pessimistic respondents, but through different channels: initial optimists lower their reservation wages and intensify search, while pessimists raise reservation wages and redirect applications toward local vacancies. Consistent with spatial search frictions, narrowing the geographic scope accelerates job finding among pessimists.

AI.tldr: 在丹麦9000名求职者的实地实验中，研究发现通过提供可比工人再就业工资信息来调整失业者的工资预期，能够提高就业率。干预对初始乐观者和悲观者都有效，但机制不同：乐观者降低保留工资并加强搜索，悲观者提高保留工资并将申请转向本地职位。
AI.research_question: 失业工人的工资预期如何影响其求职行为和再就业结果？
AI.motivation: 理解工资预期在求职决策中的作用对于设计有效的就业政策至关重要，但现有研究缺乏关于工资预期如何影响实际求职行为和就业结果的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于求职理论、工资预期理论和空间搜索摩擦理论，研究工资预期调整对求职行为和就业结果的影响机制。
AI.method: 对9000名丹麦失业工人进行实地实验，随机将一半参与者提供可比工人的再就业工资信息，创造工资预期的外生变化，并使用行政数据追踪就业结果。
AI.findings: 干预提高了所有参与者的就业率，但机制因初始预期而异：初始乐观者降低保留工资并加强搜索强度，初始悲观者提高保留工资并将申请转向本地职位。空间搜索摩擦的减少加速了悲观者的就业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了工资预期影响求职行为的因果证据，揭示了不同初始预期群体的异质性反应机制，验证了空间搜索摩擦理论在求职过程中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为就业服务机构提供了基于信息干预的有效政策工具，建议针对不同预期类型的求职者采取差异化干预策略，特别是通过减少空间搜索摩擦来帮助悲观者。

title: Migration and the Making of the English Middle Class
affiliations: Stanford University and

detail.title: Migration and the Making of the English Middle Class
detail.abstract: When do people identify with their class? Evidence from social psychology shows that individuals are more likely to identify with a group if they are similar to its members. We study early 20th century Britain and show that regional cultural heterogeneity combined with internal migration influenced class identity. We develop and validate a measure of class identity using naming decisions. Exploiting within-household variation, we show that migration patterns that increased the local share of culturally-distant workers reduced working class identification. Where migration increased the cultural distance of the working class, workers were less likely to join unions, voters were less likely to support the nascent Labour Party, and parliamentary candidates were less likely to target working class voters. By 1911, slower in-migration and rising local population growth reduced working class distance in urban areas, which also became strongholds of support for Labour. Migration alters social identity and creates political cleavages.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了20世纪初英国阶级认同的形成机制，发现区域文化异质性和内部移民通过影响工人阶级的文化距离来塑造阶级认同，进而影响工会参与、工党支持等政治行为。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下人们会认同自己的阶级？区域文化异质性和内部移民如何影响工人阶级认同的形成？
AI.motivation: 社会心理学研究表明个体更可能认同与自己相似的群体，但现实中阶级认同的形成机制尚不明确。研究早期20世纪英国的情况有助于理解文化差异和人口流动如何塑造社会认同和政治分野。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认同理论（个体更可能认同与自己相似的群体）、文化距离理论、移民与社会认同形成理论、阶级认同与政治行为关联理论。
AI.method: 使用命名决策作为阶级认同的测量指标，利用家庭内部变异进行分析，考察移民模式对本地文化距离的影响，并分析其对工会参与、工党投票和候选人策略的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 增加本地文化距离较远的工人比例的移民模式会降低工人阶级认同；2. 工人阶级文化距离增加时，工人加入工会的可能性降低；3. 选民支持新兴工党的可能性降低；4. 议会候选人较少针对工人阶级选民；5. 到1911年，移民放缓和地方人口增长减少了城市地区的工人阶级距离，这些地区也成为工党的支持据点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了基于命名决策的阶级认同测量方法；2. 揭示了文化距离在阶级认同形成中的关键作用；3. 建立了移民、文化异质性、阶级认同和政治行为之间的理论联系；4. 为理解社会认同的动态变化提供了历史实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释了早期英国工党支持的地理分布模式；2. 为理解移民对社会认同和政治分野的影响提供了历史借鉴；3. 对当代移民政策和区域发展政策具有启示意义；4. 为研究社会认同的形成机制提供了可操作的方法论工具。

title: Driving Innovation: The Policy Tools Powering Electric Vehicle Technological Inventions
affiliations: and Syracuse University - Department of Public Administration

detail.title: Driving Innovation: The Policy Tools Powering Electric Vehicle Technological Inventions
detail.abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are crucial for cutting transportation emissions, yet the policy drivers of EV innovation remain underexplored. This study analyzes firm-level panel data on EV and battery patents, covering more than 4,000 firms across 19 countries from 2010 to 2021, to assess how these policy tools and their interactions in different time horizons influence innovative activity. We test the effects of individual policy instruments that either raise demand for EVs or support the development of EV technologies. Stringent fuel-economy standards, financial incentives, adoption targets, and public R&D investments each significantly increase patenting in EV and battery technologies. Moreover, long-term EV targets amplify the innovative impact of public R&D and standards while diminishing the marginal effect of short-term price signals. The results suggest that governments can accelerate clean automotive innovation by combining long-term adoption commitments with sustained R&D investment or strong performance standards, and by managing these instruments as a coordinated policy portfolio rather than as separate tools. The study contributes cross-country, firm-level evidence that links policy design to the direction of clean technology innovation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析19个国家4000多家企业2010-2021年的电动汽车和电池专利数据，发现燃料经济性标准、财政激励、采用目标和公共研发投资都能显著促进创新，且长期目标能放大公共研发和标准的效果，同时减弱短期价格信号的边际效应。
AI.research_question: 不同政策工具及其在不同时间范围内的相互作用如何影响电动汽车技术创新活动？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车对减少交通排放至关重要，但政策如何驱动电动汽车创新的机制尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策工具理论、创新系统理论、技术变革理论，关注需求拉动与供给推动政策的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用2010-2021年19个国家4000多家企业的电动汽车和电池专利面板数据，分析不同政策工具及其交互作用对创新活动的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 严格的燃料经济性标准、财政激励、采用目标和公共研发投资都能显著增加电动汽车和电池技术专利；2. 长期电动汽车目标能放大公共研发和标准对创新的影响；3. 长期目标会减弱短期价格信号的边际效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了政策设计与清洁技术创新方向之间关系的跨国、企业层面证据，强调了政策组合协调而非单独工具的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 政府可以通过结合长期采用承诺与持续研发投资或强性能标准来加速清洁汽车创新，应将政策工具作为协调的政策组合而非单独工具来管理。

title: State and Local Tax Policy in a Time of Telework
affiliations: University of California, Irvine and University of Michigan

detail.title: State and Local Tax Policy in a Time of Telework
detail.abstract: The taxing authority of subnational governments is limited by the geographic location of individuals and economic activity. The rise of telework decouples a worker's residence from the employer's location, creating challenges for personal income taxes, corporate income taxes, and unemployment insurance. Using Census data, we show that teleworkers are more likely than non-teleworkers to move interstate and realize larger reductions in their state tax burdens from a move. Motivated by this evidence, we evaluate alternative principles for sourcing labor income to the state of residence, the employer, or work and discuss how remote work reshapes subnational tax bases.

AI.tldr: 远程工作使员工居住地与雇主所在地分离，挑战了州级个人所得税、企业所得税和失业保险的征收。研究发现远程工作者更可能跨州迁移并获得更大的州税减免，这促使重新思考劳动收入应归属于居住州、雇主州还是工作州。
AI.research_question: 远程工作如何影响州级税收管辖权？劳动收入应如何在不同州之间分配？
AI.motivation: 远程工作打破了传统税收管辖的地理限制，使员工居住地与雇主所在地分离，对州级个人所得税、企业所得税和失业保险的征收构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收管辖权理论、地理经济学、劳动力流动性理论
AI.method: 使用美国人口普查数据，比较远程工作者与非远程工作者的跨州迁移行为和州税负担变化
AI.findings: 远程工作者比非远程工作者更可能跨州迁移，且通过迁移能获得更大的州税减免
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了远程工作时代州级税收管辖权的新理论框架，探讨了劳动收入归属的三种原则（居住地、雇主所在地、工作地）
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对远程工作税收挑战的具体建议，帮助重新设计州级税收体系以适应新的工作模式

title: Financial Sanction, Exchange Rate Volatility and Macroeconomic Variables (Case of Iran)
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Financial Sanction, Exchange Rate Volatility and Macroeconomic Variables (Case of Iran)
detail.abstract: Financial sanctions have economic consequences for the oil-dependent economies. We examined the impact of financial sanctions on exchange rate fluctuations and macroeconomic variables in Iran. To this end, we employed a new Keynesian DSGE model. The results indicated that with the shock in foreign exchange, production (Y) and imports initially decreased. Oil production has shown a positive reaction initially and a negative reaction in the medium term, and after 7 periods, the effect of the shock has disappeared. The capital stock (K) also decreased initially, and in two periods, it reacted positively. In the tenth period, its effect disappeared, and in the long term, it became partially negative, and its effect disappeared. The inflation rate has decreased initially, and its effect disappeared over time. Consumption decreased, and after five cycles, the reaction became positive and then disappeared. The interest rate increased initially and then decreased, and in the 10th period, the shock effect disappeared. The exchange rate initially decreased and then increased after one period.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用新凯恩斯DSGE模型分析金融制裁对伊朗汇率波动和宏观经济变量的影响。结果显示，外汇冲击导致生产和进口最初下降，石油生产短期正向反应但中期转为负向，资本存量先降后升，通胀率下降，消费减少后回升，利率先升后降，汇率先降后升。
AI.research_question: 金融制裁如何影响伊朗的汇率波动和宏观经济变量？
AI.motivation: 金融制裁对石油依赖型经济体产生重要经济后果，需要理解其对汇率和宏观经济的具体影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型框架
AI.method: 采用新凯恩斯DSGE模型进行数值模拟分析
AI.findings:
1. 外汇冲击导致生产和进口最初下降
2. 石油生产短期正向反应，中期转为负向，7期后效应消失
3. 资本存量先降后升，长期部分负向效应
4. 通胀率下降后效应消失
5. 消费减少后回升
6. 利率先升后降
7. 汇率先降后升
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将金融制裁纳入DSGE模型分析框架
2. 揭示了金融制裁对石油依赖型经济体的动态传导机制
3. 提供了金融制裁影响宏观经济的时间路径分析
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者理解金融制裁的经济后果提供实证依据
2. 帮助伊朗等受制裁国家制定应对策略
3. 为国际组织和投资者评估制裁效果提供参考

title: Dynamics of Tourism and Economic Growth in the Oil-Exporting Economies: A Tri-Variate Causality
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Dynamics of Tourism and Economic Growth in the Oil-Exporting Economies: A Tri-Variate Causality
detail.abstract: The causality between tourism growth and economic growth would not be very accurate regardless of the environmental factors affecting them such as the oil revenues. The present study investigates the effects of oil revenues on the causality between them, to present the difference between the two variables in oil-exporting countries. We examined the causal relationship using Dumitrescu and Hurlin's model (2012) and the trivariate method in 9 oil-exporting countries from 1996 to 2019. The results show a one-way causal relationship between economic growth and tourism promotion in two variate causality but no relationship was found between them in trivariate. However, one-way causality is weakened when oil revenues are introduced. The causality of economic growth is not confirmed in the presence of oil revenues, as the causal relationship in the two-variable test is affected by the abundance of oil revenues.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨石油收入如何影响旅游增长与经济增长之间的因果关系，发现在考虑石油收入后，原本存在的单向因果关系被削弱或消失。
AI.research_question: 石油收入如何影响旅游增长与经济增长之间的因果关系？
AI.motivation: 传统研究旅游与经济增长因果关系时往往忽略环境因素（如石油收入）的影响，导致结果不准确。特别是在石油出口国，石油收入可能显著改变这两个变量之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济增长与旅游发展关系的理论，结合资源诅咒理论和环境经济学，探讨自然资源（石油）收入如何调节旅游与经济增长的因果关系。
AI.method: 使用Dumitrescu和Hurlin（2012）的因果检验模型，采用双变量和三变量方法，分析1996-2019年间9个石油出口国的数据。
AI.findings: 1. 双变量检验显示经济增长与旅游促进存在单向因果关系；2. 三变量检验（加入石油收入）中未发现两者关系；3. 引入石油收入后，单向因果关系被削弱；4. 石油收入的存在使经济增长的因果关系不再显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了石油收入作为重要调节变量在旅游-经济增长关系中的作用；2. 证明了忽略环境因素可能导致因果关系的误判；3. 为资源型经济体的旅游发展理论提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为石油出口国的政策制定者提供决策依据：在制定旅游发展政策时需考虑石油收入的影响；2. 提醒研究者分析旅游-经济关系时应纳入相关环境因素；3. 帮助理解资源丰富经济体的发展路径特殊性。

title: Avoiding Middle-income Trap in Muslim Majority Countries: The Effect of Total Factor Productivity, Human Capital, and Age Dependency Ratio International Journal of Business and Development Studies
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Avoiding Middle-income Trap in Muslim Majority Countries: The Effect of Total Factor Productivity, Human Capital, and Age Dependency Ratio International Journal of Business and Development Studies
detail.abstract: In 2010, the World Bank categorized countries in per capita gross domestic product in terms of purchasing power parity (at constant 1990 prices) in three categories: low, middle (lower and upper) and high income. If a country caught at least 28 years in lower middle income level and at least 14 years caught in upper middle-income level, then they are trapped in lower middle and upper middle income traps respectively. The growth of per capita GDP or economic growth, is a factor in avoiding middle income trap. We examined the effect of total factor productivity, human capital and age dependency ratios on GDP per capita growth and the avoidance of middle income trap during 1991-2014 for ten Islamic countries, using panel data and constant effects estimation. The findings indicate that human capital and then total factor productivity have positive and significant relationship with percapita GDP and have the greatest impact on economic growth and the avoidance from middle income trap. If the ratio of age dependency is high, it has a positive and significant effect on economic growth and can keep the country in the middle income trap.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1991-2014年间十个伊斯兰国家如何避免中等收入陷阱，发现人力资本和全要素生产率对人均GDP增长和避免中等收入陷阱有显著正向影响，而高年龄依赖比对经济增长有正向影响但可能使国家陷入中等收入陷阱。
AI.research_question: 人力资本、全要素生产率和年龄依赖比对人均GDP增长和避免中等收入陷阱有何影响？
AI.motivation: 中等收入陷阱是许多发展中国家面临的挑战，特别是伊斯兰国家。理解影响经济增长和避免中等收入陷阱的关键因素对这些国家的经济发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于世界银行的中等收入陷阱定义（低收入国家在中等收入水平停留特定年限），结合经济增长理论，特别是人力资本、全要素生产率对经济增长的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1991-2014年十个伊斯兰国家的面板数据，采用固定效应估计方法，分析人力资本、全要素生产率和年龄依赖比对人均GDP增长的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 人力资本对人均GDP增长有最显著的正向影响，有助于避免中等收入陷阱
2. 全要素生产率对经济增长有显著正向影响
3. 高年龄依赖比对经济增长有正向影响，但可能使国家陷入中等收入陷阱
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了人力资本和全要素生产率在避免中等收入陷阱中的关键作用
2. 揭示了年龄依赖比对经济增长的复杂影响机制
3. 为中等收入陷阱理论提供了伊斯兰国家的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为伊斯兰国家制定经济发展政策提供指导
2. 强调投资人力资本和提高全要素生产率的重要性
3. 提醒政策制定者注意人口结构变化对经济增长的影响

title: Review of “Economics in the Time of COVID-19”1 by Baldwin and Mauro
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Review of “Economics in the Time of COVID-19”1 by Baldwin and Mauro
detail.abstract: This review provides an assessment of the collection of contributions on the economic issues of COVID-19. The paper focused on the structure of the book and chapters" content, quality of the publication, missing topics, predictions, and the pandemic effects on poverty and inequality. As the book is written during the initial stages of the pandemic, it does not contain the digital economy, cryptocurrency, health economics issues, sovereign debt, and resilience. The book is a useful text for graduate students in Economics and illuminating for economic policies during the COVID-19 pandemic. .

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于COVID-19经济问题论文集的书评，评估了该书的章节结构、内容质量、缺失主题、预测以及疫情对贫困和不平等的影响。
AI.research_question: 这本关于COVID-19经济问题的论文集在结构、内容质量、覆盖范围、预测准确性以及对贫困和不平等影响分析方面的表现如何？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行对全球经济产生了深远影响，需要系统评估相关经济研究文献，特别是早期出版的论文集，以了解其贡献和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于经济学理论框架，包括宏观经济分析、发展经济学、不平等理论等，但缺乏数字经济学、加密货币、健康经济学等新兴领域的理论视角。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和内容分析方法，系统评估论文集的章节结构、内容质量、覆盖主题范围，并识别缺失的重要议题。
AI.findings: 该书在疫情初期阶段提供了有用的经济分析，但缺乏数字经济学、加密货币、健康经济学、主权债务和韧性等关键主题。对贫困和不平等的影响分析较为突出，适合经济学研究生和政策制定者参考。
AI.theory_contributions: 整理了疫情初期经济研究的理论框架，为后续研究提供了基础，但理论创新有限，未能涵盖新兴经济领域的理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学研究生提供了有用的教材，为政策制定者在COVID-19疫情期间的经济政策制定提供了参考，但受限于出版时间，未能涵盖疫情后期的重要经济议题。

title: Inclusive Growth in Iran's Provinces (2004 -2015)
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Inclusive Growth in Iran's Provinces (2004 -2015)
detail.abstract: This paper aims to focus on inclusive growth and its impact on multidimensional poverty and inequality in Iran's provinces on the basis of social mobility index. The results suggest, that although the multidimensional poverty has decreased, participation of active labor force has a decisive role in inclusive growth and reduction of absolute multidimensional poverty of the provinces. But labor participation has been accompanied by inequality of income, which indicates that the opportunity for economic growth has been unevenly distributed, as higher income deciles have more benefits. Income inequality has moderated the positive and significant effect of GDP growth on its inclusiveness. Inflation also has a negative and significant effect on the inclusive growth of the provinces. The research findings indicate that the economic and financial policies, including the ratio of bank credit to GDP and government social expenditures, have a positive and significant effect on the acceleration of inclusive growth and have been able to generate inclusive, albeit unsustainable growth in the provinces. This inclusive growth has led to a reduction in poverty and inequality. However because of its volatility and instability, it has no significant impact on poverty and inequality and did not directly reduce poverty and inequality in the provinces.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨伊朗各省包容性增长对多维贫困和不平等的影响，发现虽然多维贫困有所减少，但劳动力参与在包容性增长和减少绝对多维贫困中起决定性作用。然而，劳动力参与伴随收入不平等，表明经济增长机会分配不均，高收入阶层获益更多。收入不平等削弱了GDP增长对包容性的积极影响，通货膨胀也对包容性增长有负面影响。经济金融政策（如银行信贷与GDP比率、政府社会支出）能加速包容性增长，但这种增长不稳定，未能显著减少贫困和不平等。
AI.research_question: 包容性增长如何影响伊朗各省的多维贫困和不平等？具体而言，包容性增长通过哪些机制影响贫困和不平等，以及经济政策在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 尽管伊朗多维贫困有所减少，但经济增长机会分配不均，高收入阶层获益更多，导致收入不平等问题突出。需要研究包容性增长如何真正减少贫困和不平等，以及经济政策如何促进可持续的包容性发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于包容性增长理论、多维贫困理论和社会流动性指数框架，分析经济增长的包容性及其对贫困和不平等的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用社会流动性指数，分析伊朗各省的数据，考察包容性增长、多维贫困、不平等、劳动力参与、GDP增长、通货膨胀、银行信贷与GDP比率、政府社会支出等变量之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 多维贫困减少，但劳动力参与在包容性增长和减少绝对多维贫困中起决定性作用；2. 劳动力参与伴随收入不平等，经济增长机会分配不均；3. 收入不平等削弱GDP增长对包容性的积极影响；4. 通货膨胀对包容性增长有负面影响；5. 经济金融政策（银行信贷与GDP比率、政府社会支出）能加速包容性增长，但这种增长不稳定，未能显著减少贫困和不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了包容性增长理论在发展中国家背景下的应用，揭示了包容性增长与多维贫困、不平等之间的复杂关系，特别是强调了增长的不稳定性如何削弱其减贫效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗政策制定者提供实证依据：1. 需要关注经济增长机会的公平分配；2. 控制通货膨胀对包容性增长至关重要；3. 经济金融政策能促进包容性增长，但需要增强其稳定性和可持续性才能真正减少贫困和不平等。

title: Bridging Iranian Exporters with Foreign Markets : Does Diaspora Matter?
affiliations: Institute for Humanities and Cultural Studies

detail.title: Bridging Iranian Exporters with Foreign Markets : Does Diaspora Matter?
detail.abstract: After matching a rich micro-level Iranian customs dataset with a macro-level cross country database on Iranian diaspora stocks, we establish that diaspora matters for dynamics of Iranian exporters. We document the extent to which Iranian emigrants foster exports through both intensive and extensive margins at the micro-level. We show that destinations with more emigrants from Iran attract more Iranian exporters and allow them to survive longer and grow faster. One plausible explanation is that the diaspora channel reduces the fixed cost of exporting that Iranian exporters incur to enter a destination, those related to creating distribution channels, and those associated with learning about market demand. Our results add firm-level insight to the burgeoning literature on the channels through which emigration could impact economic integration. As Iran is now trying to integrate more with the global economy, these results suggest that Iranian embassies across the world have a role to play in bridging the gap between Iranian diaspora and exporters through trade promotion exhibitions and workshops to encourage greater trade between Iran and the rest of the world.

AI.tldr: 本文通过匹配伊朗海关微观数据与宏观侨民数据库，发现侨民对伊朗出口商动态有重要影响：侨民多的目的地能吸引更多伊朗出口商，并帮助他们在当地生存更久、增长更快，主要通过降低出口固定成本（如分销渠道建立、市场需求了解等）来实现。
AI.research_question: 伊朗侨民如何影响伊朗出口商的动态表现？具体通过哪些机制影响出口的集约边际和扩展边际？
AI.motivation: 伊朗正试图加强与全球经济的一体化，而侨民作为潜在的经济桥梁作用尚未得到充分研究。现有文献缺乏企业层面的证据来理解侨民如何影响出口商动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论中的固定成本模型，特别是出口固定成本（包括分销渠道建立、市场信息获取等）如何被侨民网络降低，从而影响企业的出口决策和表现。
AI.method: 匹配伊朗海关微观数据集（企业层面出口数据）与宏观跨国侨民存量数据库，进行实证分析，考察侨民对出口商进入、生存和增长的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 侨民多的目的地吸引更多伊朗出口商（扩展边际）；2. 侨民帮助出口商在当地生存更久、增长更快（集约边际）；3. 机制主要是降低出口固定成本，特别是分销渠道建立和市场需求了解相关的成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 为企业层面理解侨民如何影响经济一体化提供了新证据，丰富了侨民网络降低贸易成本的理论机制，特别是固定成本降低的具体路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗政府政策提供依据：建议伊朗驻外使馆通过贸易推广展览和研讨会等方式，搭建侨民与出口商之间的桥梁，促进伊朗与世界的贸易。

title: Justice Beyond Institutions: G. A. Cohen on Choice, Equality, and Moral Responsibility

detail.title: Justice Beyond Institutions: G. A. Cohen on Choice, Equality, and Moral Responsibility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was developed independently and revised for scholarly dissemination.

detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs and critically evaluates G. A. Cohen's claim that justice is not exhausted by the design of social institutions but also depends on the choices individuals make within those institutions. Challenging John Rawls's institutional focus, Cohen argues that formally just rules can coexist with substantive injustice when individuals exploit permissible inequalities for personal advantage. Central to Cohen's critique is the idea of an egalitarian ethos-a shared moral commitment that governs personal conduct and aligns individual choice with egalitarian principles. The paper argues that Cohen offers a powerful moral insight by exposing the limitations of purely institutional accounts of justice and highlighting the role of individual agency in sustaining inequality. At the same time, it critically examines the risks of extending justice into personal morality, including increased moral demandingness, the reintroduction of individual blame, and the potential erosion of pluralism and structural responsibility. While Cohen's egalitarian ethos cannot serve as a comprehensive or action-guiding principle of justice, it functions as an important critical ideal that illuminates the moral compromises embedded in incentive-based inequalities. The paper concludes that Cohen's contribution sharpens the tension between moral aspiration and institutional feasibility, clarifying the stakes of egalitarian justice without displacing the central importance of structural critique.

AI.tldr: 本文重构并批判性评估了G.A.科恩关于正义不仅取决于社会制度设计，还取决于个人在制度内所作选择的观点。科恩挑战罗尔斯的制度中心论，认为形式公正的规则可能与实质不公正共存，当个人利用允许的不平等谋取私利时。科恩的核心概念是平等主义精神气质——一种共享的道德承诺，规范个人行为并使个人选择与平等原则保持一致。
AI.research_question: 正义是否仅由社会制度设计决定，还是也取决于个人在制度内的选择？科恩的平等主义精神气质概念能否作为正义的全面原则？
AI.motivation: 挑战约翰·罗尔斯以制度为中心的正义观，揭示形式公正的制度可能掩盖实质不公正，强调个人选择在维持不平等中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: G.A.科恩的正义理论，特别是他对罗尔斯制度主义正义观的批判；平等主义精神气质概念；个人道德责任与制度正义的关系。
AI.method: 理论分析与哲学论证：重构科恩的核心论点，批判性评估其理论内涵，分析个人道德在正义理论中的角色。
AI.findings: 科恩揭示了纯粹制度主义正义观的局限性，强调个人能动性在维持不平等中的作用。平等主义精神气质虽不能作为全面或行动指导的正义原则，但作为重要的批判性理想，揭示了基于激励的不平等中蕴含的道德妥协。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展正义概念，超越制度设计，纳入个人道德选择；2. 提出平等主义精神气质作为连接制度正义与个人行为的桥梁；3. 澄清道德理想与制度可行性之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者注意制度形式正义与实质正义之间的差距；2. 强调社会变革需要制度变革与个人道德转变相结合；3. 为评估社会不平等提供更全面的分析框架，既关注结构因素也关注个人选择。

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the causal effect of job quality on the physical and mental health of older European workers. We combine longitudinal data from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) with occupation-and country-level jobquality measures from the European Working Conditions Survey (EWCS) for 14 European countries. To address endogenous occupational sorting, we focus on workers who remain within the same 3-digit ISCO occupation across waves, and estimate individual fixed-effects models that exploit exogenous within-occupation changes in working conditions over time. We find that deteriorations in job quality significantly worsen health outcomes. In particular, higher work intensity, poorer working time quality, and weaker job prospects reduce mental health and selected physical health outcomes. Pronounced gender heterogeneity emerges: women's mental health is more sensitive to changes in work intensity and working time quality, while men's health is more consistently affected by job discretion, including cardiovascular risk. Institutional context further moderates these effects, with smaller health penalties in countries with stronger healthcare capacity, stricter employment protection, and more comprehensive occupational health and safety regulation. Overall, the findings highlight the role of labour market conditions as causal determinants of health and the importance of integrated policy responses in ageing societies.

AI.tldr: 该研究估计了工作质量对欧洲老年工作者身心健康的因果效应，发现工作质量恶化显著损害健康，且存在性别异质性和制度调节效应。
AI.research_question: 工作质量对欧洲老年工作者的身心健康有何因果效应？这种效应是否存在性别差异？制度环境如何调节这些效应？
AI.motivation: 在人口老龄化背景下，理解工作条件如何影响老年工作者的健康对于制定有效的劳动力市场政策和公共卫生政策至关重要。现有研究多关注工作与健康的相关性，但缺乏因果证据，且对老年工作者群体关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作压力模型、工作要求-控制模型等职业健康心理学理论，结合生命历程视角，探讨工作质量（包括工作强度、工作时间质量、工作前景等维度）对健康的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）的纵向数据与欧洲工作条件调查（EWCS）的职业和国家层面工作质量指标，覆盖14个欧洲国家。采用个体固定效应模型，关注在同一3位数ISCO职业内跨波次保持不变的工人，以利用职业内工作条件随时间的外生变化来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 工作质量恶化显著损害健康结果；2. 较高的工作强度、较差的工作时间质量和较弱的工作前景会降低心理健康和部分身体健康指标；3. 存在显著的性别异质性：女性的心理健康对工作强度和工作时间质量的变化更敏感，而男性的健康（包括心血管风险）更受工作自主权的影响；4. 制度环境调节效应：在医疗能力更强、就业保护更严格、职业健康安全法规更全面的国家，健康惩罚效应更小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为工作质量对健康的因果效应提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了工作质量影响健康的性别差异机制；3. 阐明了制度环境在调节工作-健康关系中的作用；4. 将职业健康研究与老龄化研究相结合，拓展了生命历程视角下的工作-健康关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改善老年工作者健康的针对性建议：关注工作强度、工作时间安排和工作自主权；2. 强调了性别敏感政策的重要性；3. 指出加强医疗体系、就业保护和职业健康安全法规可以减轻工作条件对健康的负面影响；4. 为老龄化社会中的综合政策响应提供了依据。

title: Generalized Method of Moments with Partially Missing Data
affiliations: University of Southern California and University of Southern California - Department of Economics

detail.title: Generalized Method of Moments with Partially Missing Data

publicationDetails.journalName: USC Center for Economic & Social Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We consider a generalized method of moments framework in which a part of the data
vector is missing for some units in a completely unrestricted, potentially endogenous
way. In this setup, the parameters of interest are usually only partially identified. We
characterize the identified set for such parameters using the support function of the
convex set of moment predictions consistent with the data. This identified set is sharp,
valid for both continuous and discrete data, and straightforward to estimate. We also
propose a statistic for testing hypotheses and constructing confidence regions for the true
parameter, show that standard nonparametric bootstrap may not be valid, and suggest
a fix using the bootstrap for directionally differentiable functionals of Fang and Santos
(2019). A set of Monte Carlo simulations demonstrates that both our estimator and the
confidence region perform well when samples are moderately large and the data have
bounded supports.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种处理部分数据缺失的广义矩方法框架，其中数据向量的一部分可能以完全无限制、潜在内生的方式缺失。作者使用矩预测凸集的支撑函数来刻画部分识别参数的识别集，并提出了假设检验和置信区域构建的统计量。
AI.research_question: 在广义矩方法框架中，当部分数据以完全无限制、潜在内生的方式缺失时，如何刻画参数的识别集并进行统计推断？
AI.motivation: 实际应用中经常遇到数据缺失问题，特别是当缺失机制完全无限制且可能内生时，传统方法难以处理。这种情况下参数通常只能部分识别，需要新的方法来刻画识别集并进行统计推断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义矩方法框架、部分识别理论、凸集支撑函数、方向可微泛函的bootstrap方法
AI.method: 使用矩预测凸集的支撑函数来刻画识别集，提出基于方向可微泛函bootstrap的假设检验和置信区域构建方法，通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证方法性能
AI.findings: 提出的识别集是尖锐的，适用于连续和离散数据，且易于估计。当样本量中等且数据有界支撑时，估计量和置信区域表现良好。标准非参数bootstrap可能无效，但使用Fang和Santos的方向可微泛函bootstrap可以修正。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为数据缺失情况下的广义矩方法提供了部分识别的理论框架；2. 使用凸集支撑函数刻画尖锐识别集；3. 发展了基于方向可微泛函bootstrap的统计推断方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了处理数据缺失问题的实用估计方法；2. 给出了有效的假设检验和置信区域构建工具；3. 通过模拟验证了方法在中等样本量下的良好性能

detail.abstract:
Since the turn of the millennium, we have experienced a proliferation of international agreements in the intellectual property arena, with a number of them having significant implications for environmental sustainability. Some, like the Anti-Counterfeiting Trade Agreement and the WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge, focus primarily on intellectual property issues. By contrast, others such as the Trans-Pacific Partnership Agreement and the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, contains an intellectual property chapter as well as many other chapters. How all of these instruments interact with each other and with other international agreements at the intersection of intellectual property and environmental sustainability deserves our attention.

This chapter focuses on the interplay between different intellectual property and intellectual property-related agreements in the environmental sustainability context. It begins by discussing three clusters of international agreements: (1) intellectual property agreements; (2) free trade or economic partnership agreements that contain intellectual property chapters; and (3) other international agreements that contain intellectual property-relevant provisions. The chapter then underscores the importance of viewing all of these agreements as interactive units as part of the fast-expanding international intellectual property regime complex. The chapter concludes by outlining four directions for further research at the intersection of intellectual property and environmental sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了知识产权与环境可持续性交叉领域的国际协议互动关系，分析了三类国际协议集群及其相互作用，并提出了未来研究的四个方向。
AI.research_question: 不同知识产权及相关协议在环境可持续性背景下如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 21世纪以来，知识产权领域的国际协议激增，其中许多对环境可持续性有重要影响。这些协议包括专门的知识产权协议、包含知识产权章节的自由贸易协定，以及其他包含知识产权相关条款的国际协议。这些协议之间以及与其他国际协议的互动关系值得关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际知识产权制度复合体理论，强调将各类协议视为快速扩张的国际知识产权制度复合体中的互动单元。
AI.method: 文献分析和理论框架构建，通过分类讨论三类国际协议集群：1)知识产权协议；2)包含知识产权章节的自由贸易或经济伙伴关系协议；3)包含知识产权相关条款的其他国际协议。
AI.findings: 识别了知识产权与环境可持续性交叉领域的三类国际协议集群，强调了将这些协议视为国际知识产权制度复合体中互动单元的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在环境可持续性背景下分析知识产权协议互动关系的理论框架，强调制度复合体视角的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了理解知识产权与环境可持续性交叉领域国际协议互动的分析框架，并指出了未来研究的四个具体方向。

detail.abstract: The Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) is a nationally representative longitudinal study of approximately 8700 U.S. families. Since 2003, the PSID has used various Event History Calendars (EHC’s) for capturing retrospective reports. The first electronic version of the EHC was built as a stand- alone component to collect employment history of the main respondent and their spouse. In 2007, new childhood health calendar was added. The new calendar was designed to collect information on the most common childhood medical conditions including asthma, diabetes and allergies. This new childhood health calendar was programmed using Visual Basic but integrated into the Blaise application so it appeared seamless to the interviewer. The Blaise DEP (Data Entry Program) called the VB application and data from the childhood calendar was written back to the bdb using a Dynamic Link Library (DLL). Given the success of the childhood health EHC, in 2009 the complex employment Event History Calendar was reprogrammed in a similar integrated fashion. This paper will discuss the development of the new employment EHC, specifically how we incorporated a number of checks and warnings to the interviewers in order to meet the complex requirements of collecting information about employment and labor force participation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PSID调查中就业事件历史日历(EHC)的开发过程，重点讨论了如何通过集成检查与警告机制来满足复杂的就业数据收集需求。

title: Kotlarski's Lemma for Dyadic Models
affiliations: University of Southern California and University of Southern California - Department of Economics

detail.title: Kotlarski's Lemma for Dyadic Models

publicationDetails.journalName: USC Center for Economic & Social Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show how to identify the distributions of the latent components in the twoway dyadic model for bipartite networks y i,ℓ = α i + η ℓ + ε i,ℓ. This is achieved by a repeated application of the extension of the classical lemma of Kotlarski (1967) in Evdokimov and White (2012). We provide two separate sets of assumptions under which all the latent distributions are identified. Both rely on some of the latent components being identically distributed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种识别双向二分网络模型中潜在成分分布的方法，通过重复应用Kotlarski引理的扩展版本，在两组不同假设下实现了所有潜在分布的识别。
AI.research_question: 如何在双向二分网络模型y_i,ℓ = α_i + η_ℓ + ε_i,ℓ中识别潜在成分α_i、η_ℓ和ε_i,ℓ的分布？
AI.motivation: 二分网络模型在经济学和社会科学中广泛应用，但模型中潜在成分的分布识别一直是个挑战。现有方法通常需要强假设或只能识别部分参数，需要开发更一般的识别方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kotlarski (1967)引理及其在Evdokimov和White (2012)中的扩展，构建了双向二分网络模型的识别理论框架。
AI.method: 通过重复应用Kotlarski引理的扩展版本，在两组不同的假设条件下（都要求某些潜在成分同分布）进行识别分析。
AI.findings: 在两组不同的假设下都能实现所有潜在成分分布的完全识别。两组假设都要求某些潜在成分具有相同的分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 为双向二分网络模型提供了新的识别理论，扩展了Kotlarski引理的应用范围，为处理更复杂的网络模型提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了识别二分网络模型中潜在成分分布的具体方法，有助于更准确地估计网络效应和进行因果推断。

title: Horizontal Policies in Russian Public Procurement: Ideologies, Values and Narratives
affiliations: Southern Federal University and

detail.title: Horizontal Policies in Russian Public Procurement: Ideologies, Values and Narratives

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the grant of Russian Science Foundation No. 24-18-00665, https://rscf.ru/en/project/24-18-00665/ “Ideological landscape of Russian economic science” at Southern Federal University.

detail.abstract: The purpose of this research is to determine the types of horizontal policies in Russian public procurement and to correlate the tools for its implementation with a particular economic ideology. The authors conduct analysis of the provisions of Russian procurement law No. 44-FZ to reveal horizontal policies and economic ideologies based on the methodology of narrative economics. Next, the authors analyse transcripts of meetings of the State Duma of Russia using the PRISMA method to identify widespread ideological ideas about the economy among legislators. Thus, elements of the ideology of economic nationalism and dirigisme are broadly discussed by the deputies. The authors found only a few narratives regarding environmental or social horizontal policies. It means that the corresponding ideologies are not on the agenda of social processes in Russia in relation to public procurement.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了俄罗斯公共采购中的横向政策类型，并将其实施工具与特定经济意识形态相关联。研究发现俄罗斯立法者主要讨论经济民族主义和统制主义意识形态，而环境或社会横向政策的叙事较少。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯公共采购中存在哪些类型的横向政策？这些政策的实施工具与何种经济意识形态相关联？
AI.motivation: 理解俄罗斯公共采购政策背后的经济意识形态基础，分析立法者在制定采购政策时的意识形态倾向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事经济学方法，用于分析法律文本和立法讨论中的意识形态叙事；经济意识形态理论（包括经济民族主义、统制主义等）。
AI.method: 1. 分析俄罗斯采购法No.44-FZ的条款，揭示横向政策和经济意识形态；2. 使用PRISMA方法分析俄罗斯国家杜马会议记录，识别立法者中普遍存在的经济意识形态观念。
AI.findings: 1. 俄罗斯立法者广泛讨论经济民族主义和统制主义意识形态；2. 关于环境或社会横向政策的叙事很少；3. 相应的环境和社会意识形态在俄罗斯公共采购相关的社会进程中未提上议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将叙事经济学方法应用于公共采购政策分析，建立了横向政策工具与经济意识形态之间的关联框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解采购政策意识形态基础的框架，揭示了俄罗斯公共采购政策制定的意识形态倾向，有助于国际社会理解俄罗斯的政策取向。

title: The Latombe Test: A Rule-of-Law Framework for Ex-Ante Governance of Algorithms

detail.title: The Latombe Test: A Rule-of-Law Framework for Ex-Ante Governance of Algorithms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent compliance consultant specializing in GDPR and algorithmic governance. This position paper was developed independently without external funding or sponsorship. The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could inappropriately influence the work presented.

detail.abstract:
On 3 September 2025, the General Court of the European Union rendered judgment in Latombe v European Commission (T-553/23). The ruling is commonly understood as a decision on data transfers to the United States under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. That reading is too narrow.

This position paper advances the position that the Latombe judgment introduces a generally applicable governance framework for any automated decision-making system (ADMS) that makes, or materially influences, decisions about natural persons. The judgment articulates four interconnected conditions that a system must satisfy to provide adequate protection of fundamental rights:

1. Procedural legitimation in advance
2. Limits by design
3. Independent oversight with enforcement power
4. Transparency about changes

We designate this framework as the Latombe test: an analytical and normative assessment framework applicable to algorithms, AI systems, and other forms of automated decision-making used by public authorities and private actors.

Central thesis: Every system that makes decisions about people—whether for surveillance, fraud detection, benefits allocation, recruitment, or credit assessment—must satisfy all four layers of the Latombe test. Systems that cannot do so lack adequate safeguards and should not be authorized for deployment.

This position paper is intended for policymakers, regulators, administrators, and legal practitioners responsible for the deployment, supervision, or assessment of automated decision-making systems.

AI.tldr: 欧盟法院Latombe判决为所有自动化决策系统建立了四层治理框架，要求系统必须满足程序合法性、设计限制、独立监督和透明度变更四个条件才能部署使用。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院Latombe判决如何为自动化决策系统建立普遍适用的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 现有对Latombe判决的理解过于狭隘，仅关注美欧数据隐私框架下的数据传输问题，而忽略了该判决为所有自动化决策系统建立的普遍治理原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟法院判例法，构建自动化决策系统的治理框架理论，包括程序合法性、设计限制、独立监督和透明度变更四个核心原则。
AI.method: 法律分析和判例解释方法，对欧盟法院Latombe判决进行深入分析，提炼出普遍适用的治理原则框架。
AI.findings: Latombe判决确立了四层治理框架：1）事前程序合法性；2）设计限制；3）具有执行权的独立监督；4）变更透明度。所有关于自然人的自动化决策系统都必须满足这四个条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"Latombe测试"作为算法、AI系统和自动化决策的分析和规范性评估框架，扩展了数据保护法在自动化决策领域的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构、管理者和法律从业者提供了具体的评估工具，用于部署、监督和评估自动化决策系统，确保基本权利得到充分保护。

title: Pole-Mounted Solar PV Retrofits: A Techno-Economic Feasibility Framework for Multi-Use Energy Infrastructure
affiliations: Solar Innovation Researcher,Bhopal , Madhya Pradesh, India

detail.title: Pole-Mounted Solar PV Retrofits: A Techno-Economic Feasibility Framework for Multi-Use Energy Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interest

detail.abstract:
Electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure and distributed renewable generation remain constrained
across Asia, MENA, Africa, and rural regions of the United States due to land acquisition
challenges, high capital costs, and slow deployment cycles. This paper proposes a utility
pole–mounted solar photovoltaic (PV) retrofit model that leverages existing electrical and street
infrastructure to enable large-scale solar deployment without additional land use.
Using Bhopal, India as a reference case, the study evaluates the technical and economic
feasibility of retrofitting approximately 30,000–65,000 utility poles, enabling the deployment of
an estimated 900,000–1,200,000 solar panels through variable inter-pole spacing. Structural
validation is demonstrated through scaled, weight-matched prototype testing aligned with IEC
wind-load standards applicable to Asia and MENA regions.
The proposed system integrates data-driven performance optimization, including solar position
modeling, inverter-level control, and soiling-loss detection, to improve energy yield and
operational efficiency under real-world conditions. Beyond electricity generation, the model
supports multi-use infrastructure applications, including EV charging, grid export, digital
advertising power supply, satellite-based public connectivity, and carbon credit generation,
allowing multiple revenue streams from a single physical asset.
The framework is designed for phased deployment, beginning with institutional campuses and
parking facilities, and scaling to city-wide and rural landowner partnerships, including U.S. ranch
properties where land utilization constraints differ. By combining existing infrastructure,
conservative performance assumptions, and long-term asset lifecycles, this study demonstrates
that pole-mounted solar retrofits represent a scalable, low-land-impact pathway for accelerating
renewable energy and EV infrastructure deployment globally.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用现有电线杆安装太阳能光伏板的改造模型，通过利用现有电力基础设施实现大规模太阳能部署而无需额外用地，以印度博帕尔为案例研究技术经济可行性，并支持多种应用场景如电动汽车充电、电网输出等。
AI.research_question: 如何利用现有电线杆基础设施部署太阳能光伏系统，以解决亚洲、中东、非洲和美国农村地区电动汽车基础设施和分布式可再生能源发电面临的用地获取困难、高资本成本和部署周期长的问题？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车基础设施和分布式可再生能源发电在亚洲、中东、非洲和美国农村地区受到用地获取困难、高资本成本和部署周期长的制约，需要创新的解决方案来加速可再生能源部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施共享理论、分布式能源系统优化理论、多用途基础设施经济学理论，以及基于现有资产利用的可持续发展框架。
AI.method: 以印度博帕尔为参考案例，评估3万-6.5万根电线杆改造的技术经济可行性；采用比例缩放、重量匹配的原型测试进行结构验证；整合数据驱动的性能优化，包括太阳位置建模、逆变器级控制和积尘损失检测。
AI.findings: 电线杆太阳能改造在技术上可行，通过可变杆间距可部署90万-120万块太阳能板；结构验证符合IEC风荷载标准；系统支持多种应用场景，可产生多种收入来源；该模型具有可扩展性，对土地影响小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于现有基础设施的分布式可再生能源部署新理论框架；发展了多用途基础设施经济学模型；为基础设施共享和资源优化利用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需额外用地的太阳能部署解决方案；支持电动汽车充电、电网输出、数字广告供电、卫星公共连接和碳信用生成等多种应用；设计了分阶段部署策略；为全球可再生能源和电动汽车基础设施加速部署提供了可行路径。

reference: Office of Financial Research Working Paper No. 26-01
title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Capital Constraints
affiliations: Office of Financial Research, U.S. Department of the Treasury, , Office of Financial Research and Independent

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Capital Constraints

publicationDetails.detailsText: Office of Financial Research Working Paper No. 26-01
publicationDetails.journalName: Office of Financial Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper quantifies the effect that regulatory capital requirements have on bank lending and real economic activity. Exploiting a change in capital requirements by the Federal Reserve at the onset of the pandemic recession, it establishes causally that looser requirements increased the ability for banks to extend credit to consumers. On average, banks that received relatively more balance sheet space from the policy change passed this along to their customers in the form of relatively higher credit limits from Q2 2020 to Q1 2021. This also led to relatively higher credit card borrowing among these customers. Using a general equilibrium quantitative model calibrated to match the empirical findings, the paper shows that absent the Federal Reserve policy change, consumption would have fallen by an extra 2.7% in the three years following the pandemic recession. Motivated by these estimates, this paper evaluates the efficacy of countercyclical capital requirements and finds that such policy could lower consumption volatility over the business cycle by as much as 12%.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了监管资本要求对银行贷款和实体经济的影响。研究发现，美联储在疫情期间放松资本要求显著增加了银行向消费者提供信贷的能力，平均提高了2.7%的消费水平。基于此，作者评估了逆周期资本要求的有效性，发现这种政策可降低商业周期中消费波动达12%。
AI.research_question: 监管资本要求的变化如何影响银行信贷供给和实体经济？逆周期资本要求政策能否有效稳定经济波动？
AI.motivation: 理解监管政策（特别是资本要求）在危机时期对信贷市场和实体经济的影响，为政策制定者提供关于逆周期资本要求有效性的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行信贷供给理论、监管资本约束理论、一般均衡模型框架
AI.method: 1. 利用美联储在疫情期间资本要求变化的自然实验进行因果推断；2. 使用银行层面和消费者层面的微观数据进行实证分析；3. 构建校准的一般均衡模型量化政策效果
AI.findings: 1. 放松资本要求显著增加了银行向消费者提供信贷的能力；2. 获得更多资产负债表空间的银行提高了客户信用额度；3. 这些客户相应地增加了信用卡借款；4. 若无政策变化，消费将在疫情衰退后三年额外下降2.7%；5. 逆周期资本要求可降低消费波动达12%
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为监管资本要求影响实体经济提供了因果证据；2. 发展了量化评估逆周期资本要求效果的理论框架；3. 丰富了关于监管政策传导机制的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了逆周期资本要求有效性的实证支持；2. 量化了监管政策对消费和信贷市场的实际影响；3. 为危机时期的政策干预提供了具体指导

title: Fear & Greed Index as a Predictor for S&P 500: A Machine Learning Approach to Market Sentiment Analysis
affiliations: The University of Texas

detail.title: Fear & Greed Index as a Predictor for S&P 500: A Machine Learning Approach to Market Sentiment Analysis
detail.abstract: Could market sentiment help predict S&P 500 movements? I collected daily data from January 2020 through October 2024 to find out, testing three machine learning models-Logistic Regression, Random Forest and Decision Trees model. Initially, I could not access complete CNN historical Fear & Greed Index data. So, I combined data from two sources: GitHub repository containing historical CNN Fear & Greed data (2020 only) and direct scraping of CNN's API endpoint (2021-2024). I also collected VIX data as a complementary sentiment indicator, creating a hybrid approach that uses both real Fear & Greed Index and VIX together. The hybrid approach greatly outperformed VIX only predictions. Using just VIX as a proxy yielded 57.6% accuracy with Decision Trees. However, combining the Fear & Greed Index with VIX boosted accuracy to 68.75%, a remarkable 19.4% relative improvement. This isn't just a modest gain; for daily market prediction, which is notoriously difficult, nearly 69% accuracy represents a substantial edge. Feature importance analysis revealed that Fear & Greed features contributed 61.9% of predictive power, while VIX features added another 24.3%. The results support the idea that investor emotions create predictable patterns in the market. The hybrid approach captures different facets of sentiment: the Fear & Greed Index reflects a broader survey of market psychology, while VIX measures options implied volatility expectations. Together, they provide a more complete picture than either indicator alone. These findings align with behavioral finance theories about emotions driving short-term market inefficiencies, while demonstrating the practical value of combining multiple sentiment sources.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用机器学习模型（逻辑回归、随机森林、决策树）分析市场情绪（CNN恐惧贪婪指数和VIX）对S&P 500走势的预测能力。混合情绪指标（恐惧贪婪指数+VIX）相比仅使用VIX，预测准确率从57.6%提升至68.75%，相对提升19.4%。恐惧贪婪特征贡献61.9%预测力，VIX贡献24.3%。
AI.research_question: 市场情绪指标（特别是CNN恐惧贪婪指数和VIX的组合）能否有效预测S&P 500的每日走势？
AI.motivation: 传统市场预测模型往往忽视投资者情绪因素，而行为金融学理论认为情绪会导致短期市场无效性。作者希望通过结合多种情绪指标，探索情绪对市场预测的实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学理论，特别是投资者情绪驱动市场短期无效性的观点。恐惧贪婪指数反映市场心理调查，VIX衡量期权隐含波动率预期，两者从不同维度捕捉市场情绪。
AI.method: 收集2020年1月至2024年10月的每日数据，使用三种机器学习模型（逻辑回归、随机森林、决策树）。数据来源：CNN恐惧贪婪指数（2020年来自GitHub仓库，2021-2024年通过API爬取）和VIX数据。采用混合方法结合两种情绪指标。
AI.findings: 1. 仅使用VIX时，决策树模型准确率为57.6%；2. 结合恐惧贪婪指数和VIX后，准确率提升至68.75%（相对提升19.4%）；3. 特征重要性分析显示：恐惧贪婪特征贡献61.9%预测力，VIX特征贡献24.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证支持行为金融学关于情绪驱动市场短期无效性的理论，验证了多种情绪指标组合比单一指标更能捕捉市场心理的复杂性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供实用的市场预测工具：1. 混合情绪指标方法显著提升预测准确率；2. 在每日市场预测这一困难任务中，68.75%准确率代表实质性优势；3. 展示了数据整合（不同来源情绪数据）的实际价值。

title: Tracking 20th Century Electronics Products Innovation: Electronics Buyers' Guides
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: Tracking 20th Century Electronics Products Innovation: Electronics Buyers' Guides

declarations.funderStatement: Generous funding and support from the NBER I3 (Innovation Information Initiative) Fellowship is greatly appreciated.

detail.abstract: The electronics industry was at the center of the most important innovations of the twentieth century. Despite this, data on small, non-public and non-manufacturing electronics firms is lacking. I construct a new dataset of over 2.2 million product listings from the Electronics Magazine Annual Buyers' Guide spanning 1946 to 1988. The data tracks the rapid expansion of firms and products during the period. The listings also show the spatial reorganization of the industry, including the emergence of new clusters like Silicon Valley. I conclude that historical product offerings can serve as a new source of data for analyzing electronics industry dynamics and innovation in the twentieth century.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了1946-1988年间电子产品杂志年度买家指南的220万条产品清单数据集，揭示了电子行业企业扩张、空间重组和创新动态，为研究20世纪电子产业提供了新的数据来源。
AI.research_question: 历史产品清单数据能否作为分析20世纪电子行业动态和创新的新数据来源？
AI.motivation: 电子行业是20世纪最重要的创新中心，但缺乏关于小型、非上市和非制造电子企业的数据，现有数据不足以全面分析行业动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业动态理论、创新地理学、产业集群理论（特别是硅谷等新兴集群的形成）
AI.method: 构建新的历史数据集，收集1946-1988年间《电子杂志年度买家指南》的220万条产品清单，进行定量分析和空间分析。
AI.findings: 1. 数据追踪了该时期企业和产品的快速扩张；2. 显示了行业的空间重组，包括硅谷等新产业集群的出现；3. 历史产品清单可作为分析电子行业动态的有效数据源。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了利用历史产品清单作为产业动态分析的新数据方法论；2. 丰富了产业地理学和创新集群理论；3. 为历史产业数据分析提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 创建了覆盖1946-1988年的220万条电子产品清单数据集；2. 为研究者和政策制定者提供了分析电子行业历史发展的实用工具；3. 有助于理解产业集群形成和创新扩散的时空模式。

title: Globalization, Coercion, and Cohesion: A Global Transition
affiliations: Jadavpur University

detail.title: Globalization, Coercion, and Cohesion: A Global Transition
detail.abstract: Geoeconomics is reshaping the world in a new order. The hidden agendas of the lobby that advocates for globalization derailed. As the scale of benefit due to globalization shifts away from them, they are following the traditional strategies of colonial powers: tariffs, sanctions, anti-immigration policies, and displays of military might. So, their policy is changing from globalization to coercion. The real play initiates from here. The targeted countries began to look for ways to protect themselves. The easiest way is to accept the terms and conditions. The toughest way is to hold out against the aggressors. But it is harder to do than to say. The concept of cohesion arises here. Cohesion acts as a lever, called a “policy lever.” Like a physical lever, it yields benefits depending on the strength of cohesion and calibrated economic policies. However, there are risks of using policy levers of cohesion that arise from internal inconsistencies and divergences.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了地缘经济背景下，全球化支持者转向胁迫政策时，目标国家如何利用凝聚力作为政策杠杆来应对，以及这种杠杆的内部不一致性和分歧带来的风险。
AI.research_question: 当地缘经济重塑世界秩序，全球化支持者转向胁迫政策时，目标国家如何有效利用凝聚力作为政策杠杆来保护自身利益？这种政策杠杆面临哪些内部风险和挑战？
AI.motivation: 全球化带来的利益分配发生变化，传统全球化倡导者转向胁迫性政策（关税、制裁、反移民政策、军事展示），这迫使目标国家寻找自我保护策略。凝聚力作为一种政策杠杆的潜力及其风险需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘经济学理论、政策杠杆理论、凝聚力理论、国际关系中的胁迫与抵抗理论、全球化与反全球化理论。
AI.method: 基于理论分析的概念性研究，可能涉及案例研究或比较分析，探讨凝聚力作为政策杠杆在不同情境下的应用和效果。
AI.findings: 凝聚力可以作为有效的政策杠杆帮助目标国家应对外部胁迫，但其效果取决于凝聚力的强度和校准的经济政策。然而，这种杠杆存在内部不一致性和分歧的风险，可能削弱其有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了凝聚力作为地缘经济背景下政策杠杆的理论框架，丰富了关于国家应对胁迫策略的理论研究，为理解全球化转向胁迫时期的国际关系动态提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为目标国家提供了利用凝聚力作为政策杠杆的实践指导，帮助政策制定者评估凝聚力杠杆的风险和收益，为国家应对外部胁迫提供了策略选择框架。

title: Diagnostic tools for selecting the temporal resolution for seasonal adjustment
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank and

detail.title: Diagnostic tools for selecting the temporal resolution for seasonal adjustment
detail.abstract: Official statistics increasingly make use of higher-frequency time series. But when users ultimately are interested in a seasonally adjusted temporal aggregate of these data, we have to decide whether to perform seasonal adjustment or aggregation first. Consequently, we must weigh up the benefits of richer informational content against the increased computational requirements and the challenges presented by using more volatile and outlier-prone data. We examine this trade-off on simulated and real-world time series using a battery of diagnostics including revision size, tests on residual seasonal and calendar effects and linkage with target variables using leading adjustment procedures: DSA, WSA, X-13-ARIMA, and TRAMO-SEATS. We synthesise our findings into practical guidelines that help users choose the aggregation level that balances statistical quality and real-time usefulness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高频时间序列分析中季节调整与时间聚合的先后顺序问题，通过模拟和实证分析比较了不同调整方法，提出了平衡统计质量与实时实用性的实用指南。
AI.research_question: 当用户最终关注的是季节调整后的时间聚合数据时，应该先进行季节调整还是先进行时间聚合？
AI.motivation: 官方统计越来越多地使用高频时间序列，但用户最终需要的是季节调整后的聚合数据。需要权衡更丰富信息内容与计算需求增加、数据更易波动和异常值影响之间的利弊。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析理论，季节调整理论，数据聚合理论，统计质量评估框架
AI.method: 使用模拟和真实世界时间序列，采用包括修订规模、残差季节和日历效应检验、与目标变量关联性等诊断指标，比较DSA、WSA、X-13-ARIMA和TRAMO-SEATS等主要调整程序
AI.findings: 研究发现了季节调整与聚合顺序选择对统计质量的影响，不同调整方法在不同情境下的表现差异，以及信息丰富度与数据稳定性之间的权衡关系
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了高频时间序列处理中季节调整与聚合顺序选择的理论框架，丰富了时间序列预处理方法论，为统计质量评估提供了新的诊断指标体系
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的选择指南，帮助用户根据具体情境选择平衡统计质量和实时实用性的聚合水平，为官方统计机构的高频数据处理提供了操作建议

title: The Ecology of Identity A Systems Framework for Identity Formation, Stability, Resistance, and Change
affiliations: Deliberate Evolution Institute

detail.title: The Ecology of Identity A Systems Framework for Identity Formation, Stability, Resistance, and Change
detail.abstract: Contemporary models of identity in psychology, leadership studies, and behavioral science largely conceptualize identity as a static construct, defined by traits, roles, or narratives. While these approaches are descriptively useful, they struggle to explain persistent identity resistance, relapse under pressure, or the physiological embedding of long-term identity patterns. This paper proposes an alternative framework: the Ecology of Identity. Drawing from systems thinking, ecological models, and applied leadership research, identity is reframed as a living, adaptive system composed of interacting layers, environmental inputs, internal regulators, and biological correlates. This ecological perspective explains why identity tends toward stability rather than truth, why change efforts often fail despite insight or motivation, and how coordinated, systemlevel shifts enable durable identity transformation. The framework is presented as a foundational, cross-disciplinary lens with applications in leadership, healthcare, psychology, and human-AI systems, offering a unifying structure for future research and applied investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"身份生态学"框架，将身份重新定义为由互动层次、环境输入、内部调节器和生物相关物组成的活体适应系统，解释身份稳定性、变革阻力及持久身份转变机制。
AI.research_question: 如何从生态学视角重新概念化身份，以解释身份稳定性、变革阻力及持久身份转变的机制？
AI.motivation: 当前心理学、领导力研究和行为科学中的身份模型将身份视为静态构造（特质、角色或叙事），无法解释身份抵抗、压力下的复发或长期身份模式的生理嵌入现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份生态学框架，整合系统思维、生态学模型和应用领导力研究，将身份视为活体适应系统，包含互动层次、环境输入、内部调节器和生物相关物。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，基于跨学科整合分析，提出概念性模型而非实证研究。
AI.findings: 生态学视角能解释身份趋向稳定性而非真实性、变革努力为何常在洞察或动机存在时失败，以及协调的系统层面转变如何实现持久身份转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供跨学科的基础性理论框架，统一身份研究，将身份从静态构造转向动态生态系统视角，为未来研究提供统一结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 应用于领导力、医疗保健、心理学和人类-AI系统领域，为身份变革干预提供新视角和方法。

title: Decision Execution in Educational Organizations: Fiscal Epistemology, Decision Nodes, and Administrative Closure

detail.title: Decision Execution in Educational Organizations: Fiscal Epistemology, Decision Nodes, and Administrative Closure
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how educational organizations operate internally by treating decision-
making as the execution of epistemically admissible fiscal–administrative information, rather
than as a narrative account of professional judgment, intent, or organizational preference.
Drawing on Fiscal Epistemology, the paper defines public law, administrative records, and rule-
encoded fiscal events as primary evidence structures that determine what constitutes admissible
information, when decisions are triggered, and how organizational actions can be legitimately
closed.
The analysis introduces a descriptive framework that models organizational decision-making
through discrete decision nodes, each defined by trigger conditions, admissible evidence,
allowable actions, and recordable outputs. These nodes provide a stable observational unit for
examining how decisions are executed under fiscal and administrative constraint. Using this
framework, the paper describes variation in decision precision across governance levels,
including provincial rule design, district-level procedures, and school-level execution, without
invoking evaluative or normative criteria.
As a representational support, the paper situates rule–capital events on a fixed X–Y coordinate
plane to render institutional tension observable as a structural property of rule alignment under
fiscal constraint. Tension is treated not as a political disagreement or value conflict, but as a
patterned outcome of how admissibility rules, funding conditions, and closure requirements
interact in practice. The contribution is a reusable epistemic reading grammar that makes internal
decision mechanics legible, comparable, and portable across educational contexts, without
requiring interpretive alignment, narrative inference, or evaluative judgment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于财政认识论的组织决策分析框架，将教育组织内部运作视为财政-行政信息的可采纳性执行过程，而非专业判断或组织偏好的叙事描述。通过离散决策节点模型，分析不同治理层级的决策精度变化，并将规则-资本事件置于坐标平面可视化制度张力。
AI.research_question: 教育组织内部如何通过财政-行政信息的可采纳性执行来进行决策运作，而非依赖专业判断、意图或组织偏好的叙事描述？
AI.motivation: 传统上教育组织决策常被理解为专业判断或组织偏好的叙事过程，缺乏对财政-行政信息可采纳性执行的系统性分析，需要一种能够客观描述决策机制而不依赖解释性对齐或评价判断的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政认识论：将公共法律、行政记录和规则编码的财政事件视为决定信息可采纳性、决策触发条件和组织行动合法闭合的主要证据结构。
AI.method: 提出描述性分析框架，通过离散决策节点（包含触发条件、可采纳证据、允许行动和可记录输出）建模组织决策过程，并在X-Y坐标平面上可视化规则-资本事件，分析不同治理层级（省级规则设计、区级程序、校级执行）的决策精度变化。
AI.findings: 1. 决策精度在不同治理层级存在系统性变化；2. 制度张力表现为规则对齐在财政约束下的结构性属性，而非政治分歧或价值冲突；3. 可采纳性规则、资金条件和闭合要求的实践互动产生模式化结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 可重复使用的认识论解读语法，使内部决策机制可读、可比、可移植；2. 不依赖解释性对齐、叙事推断或评价判断的分析框架；3. 将决策视为财政-行政信息可采纳性执行的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育管理者提供客观分析决策过程的工具；2. 使跨教育情境的决策机制比较成为可能；3. 帮助识别规则、资金和程序之间的结构性张力，支持制度改进。

title: Modeling the Decay of Decision Accuracy Under Resource Constraints: A Quantitative Analysis of Zeitnot in Competitive Chess

detail.title: Modeling the Decay of Decision Accuracy Under Resource Constraints: A Quantitative Analysis of Zeitnot in Competitive Chess
detail.abstract: This research presents a quantitative and qualitative model of Decision Accuracy Decay under severe temporal resource constraints, utilizing competitive chess as a high-fidelity proxy for real-time decision-making. By evaluating a dataset of positions through 𝑛 = 120 the lens of Centipawn Loss (ACPL) and Positional Entropy, the study identifies a non-linear relationship between remaining time (𝑇) and execution accuracy. The findings indicate that while Technical Stability remains resilient under pressure, high-entropy tactical positions trigger a "Cognitive Cliff" as 𝑇 drops below the 10-second threshold. Crucially, through the analysis of "The Intuitive Peak" (Case III), the study demonstrates that highly developed pattern recognition can override temporal deficits, allowing for brilliant execution where logical calculation fails. This analysis offers a conceptual framework that may provide insights into human performance in high-stakes decision-making contexts where time acts as a limiting factor.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个决策准确性衰减的定量和定性模型，利用国际象棋作为实时决策的高保真代理，发现在时间压力下决策准确性呈现非线性衰减，技术稳定性保持韧性，但高熵战术位置在时间低于10秒时会出现"认知悬崖"，而高度发展的模式识别可以超越时间限制。
AI.research_question: 在严重时间资源约束下，决策准确性如何随时间衰减？特别是，时间压力如何影响不同复杂度决策任务的执行质量？
AI.motivation: 理解人类在高压、时间受限环境下的决策机制，为高风险决策场景（如医疗急救、金融交易、军事指挥等）提供理论框架和实用见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策准确性衰减模型、认知负荷理论、模式识别理论、时间压力下的认知表现理论。
AI.method: 使用竞争性国际象棋作为实时决策的高保真代理，通过分析120个棋局位置，采用Centipawn Loss（ACPL）和位置熵作为衡量指标，研究剩余时间与执行准确性之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 剩余时间与执行准确性呈非线性关系；2. 技术稳定性在压力下保持韧性；3. 高熵战术位置在时间低于10秒时出现"认知悬崖"；4. 高度发展的模式识别（"直觉峰值"）可以超越时间限制，在逻辑计算失败时仍能实现出色执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了决策准确性衰减的定量和定性模型，识别了"认知悬崖"现象，建立了"直觉峰值"概念，为时间压力下的认知表现理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高风险决策环境（如紧急医疗、金融交易、军事行动）提供决策支持框架，帮助设计时间压力下的训练方案和决策辅助系统。

title: The Impact of Cryptocurrency on Traditional Banking Systems

detail.title: The Impact of Cryptocurrency on Traditional Banking Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I confirm that I have no personal, financial, or professional relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived as influencing the outcomes, interpretations, or conclusions of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive personal data. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required. All data used adhere to standard academic and ethical research guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any external funding or financial support. All work was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: Cryptocurrency has emerged as a disruptive force in the global financial landscape, challenging traditional banking systems and reshaping monetary transactions. This study examines the effects of digital currencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum on banking operations, monetary policy, and financial inclusion. The research explores the opportunities and threats cryptocurrencies pose to conventional banks, including their influence on deposit mobilization, payment systems, credit creation, and risk management. Additionally, the study investigates how regulatory frameworks and central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) interact with decentralized finance (DeFi) to maintain financial stability. Using a mixed-methods approach that combines quantitative data analysis from banking reports and cryptocurrency market trends with qualitative interviews from financial experts, the study highlights that while cryptocurrencies foster financial inclusion and innovation, they also create operational, regulatory, and monetary challenges for traditional banking institutions. Recommendations are provided for banks to adapt to this evolving landscape while ensuring sustainable growth and compliance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了加密货币对传统银行体系的冲击，分析了比特币、以太坊等数字货币如何影响银行业务、货币政策和金融包容性，同时考察了监管框架和央行数字货币与去中心化金融的互动关系。
AI.research_question: 加密货币对传统银行体系的运营、货币政策和金融包容性产生了哪些具体影响？
AI.motivation: 加密货币作为全球金融格局中的颠覆性力量，正在挑战传统银行体系并重塑货币交易，需要系统研究其对银行业务、监管和金融稳定的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融创新理论、金融包容性理论、监管框架理论、货币经济学理论、风险管理理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：结合银行报告的定量数据分析、加密货币市场趋势分析，以及对金融专家的定性访谈
AI.findings: 加密货币在促进金融包容性和创新的同时，也给传统银行机构带来了运营、监管和货币方面的挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对加密货币与传统银行体系互动机制的理解，为金融创新与监管平衡提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行适应加密货币环境提供了具体建议，帮助金融机构在确保可持续增长和合规的同时应对数字货币挑战

title: Efficiency of policy response to public emergency in the construction industry: Implications for construction project management
affiliations: , , , Michigan State University, Nanyang Technological University and

detail.title: Efficiency of policy response to public emergency in the construction industry: Implications for construction project management
detail.abstract: While public emergencies have impacted the construction industry deeply, prior studies have left the response mechanisms and efficiency of construction management policies across different administrative levels during public emergencies ambiguous, and they have not adequately explored the influencing factors. Thus, this study explores the dynamic mechanisms of policy response by taking the COVID-19 pandemic as a case study, focusing on policy vertical transmission between central and local governments and horizontal diffusion among regions. This study adopts a mixed-methods design combining quantitative and qualitative analysis. The study finds that the policy response efficiency follows a U-shaped temporal evolution, aligning with project resilience theory, and identifies the major influencing mechanisms. The study provides a practical toolkit for construction enterprises to align with efficient policies, helps project managers optimize cost control and risk mitigation amid crises, and guides policymakers in designing targeted emergency policies.

AI.tldr: 该研究以COVID-19疫情为案例，探索建筑行业在突发公共事件中的政策响应机制和效率，重点关注中央与地方政府间的垂直政策传导和区域间的水平扩散，发现政策响应效率呈U型时间演变模式。
AI.research_question: 在突发公共事件中，不同行政层级建筑管理政策的响应机制和效率是什么？影响这些政策响应的关键因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 先前研究对突发公共事件中建筑行业政策响应的机制和效率认识模糊，未能充分探索影响因素，而突发公共事件对建筑行业影响深远，需要深入理解政策响应动态机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目韧性理论（Project Resilience Theory）作为主要理论框架，用于解释政策响应效率的时间演变模式。
AI.method: 采用混合方法设计，结合定量分析和定性分析，以COVID-19疫情为案例研究。
AI.findings: 政策响应效率遵循U型时间演变模式，与项目韧性理论一致；识别了主要的影响机制；揭示了中央与地方政府间的垂直政策传导和区域间的水平扩散机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对建筑行业政策响应动态机制的理解，验证了项目韧性理论在政策响应效率演变中的应用，为政策传导和扩散理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑企业提供实用工具包以对接高效政策；帮助项目经理在危机中优化成本控制和风险缓解；指导政策制定者设计有针对性的应急政策。

title: The Narrative Consistency Premium: Ex-Ante Evidence from International Art Auctions
affiliations: Singapore University of Social Sciences

detail.title: The Narrative Consistency Premium: Ex-Ante Evidence from International Art Auctions
detail.abstract: This study empirically examines a core implication of Shiller’s narrative economics in the fine-art auction market using a transparent, metadata-only ex-ante proxy for narrative consistency. Using 4,700 auction transactions for 12 internationally traded contemporary artists (1984–2025), we compute ex-ante NCI based strictly on information available prior to each sale and estimate its pricing implications in hedonic regressions with artist and sale-year fixed effects, medium fixed effects, and standard controls (including a quadratic size term). A one-standard-deviation increase in ex-ante NCI is associated with an 8.1% higher hammer price (β = 0.078, p < 0.001; N = 4,269). Quantile regressions show that this premium is strongest in the lower-to-middle quantiles and attenuates in the upper tail, becoming statistically indistinguishable from zero at the top deciles. The main effect is supported by exact randomization inference and complemented by placebo tests, wild cluster bootstrap, and leave-one-artist-out analysis. Overall, the findings suggest that narrative consistency operates as a behavioral valuation cue—enhancing processing fluency and reducing ambiguity—particularly where information frictions are most acute.

AI.tldr: 该研究在艺术品拍卖市场检验了叙事一致性的定价效应，发现事前叙事一致性指数每增加一个标准差，拍卖价格提高8.1%，这种效应在中低价格区间最显著，在高价格区间减弱。
AI.research_question: 事前叙事一致性是否影响艺术品拍卖价格？这种影响在不同价格区间如何变化？
AI.motivation: 基于Shiller的叙事经济学理论，研究叙事一致性作为行为估值线索在艺术品市场中的作用，艺术品市场存在信息不对称和估值不确定性，叙事可能影响投资者决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: Shiller的叙事经济学理论，行为金融学中的处理流畅性和模糊性减少理论，信息摩擦理论。
AI.method: 使用4,700个拍卖交易数据（12位国际当代艺术家，1984-2025年），构建事前叙事一致性指数（仅使用拍卖前可用信息），采用特征价格回归（含艺术家、年份、媒介固定效应和标准控制变量），分位数回归分析不同价格区间的效应。
AI.findings: 事前叙事一致性指数每增加一个标准差，拍卖价格提高8.1%（β=0.078，p<0.001）。分位数回归显示这种溢价在中低分位数最强，在高端分位数减弱，在最高十分位数统计上不显著。结果通过随机化推断、安慰剂检验、聚类自助法和留一艺术家分析得到验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 为叙事经济学提供了实证支持，展示了叙事一致性作为行为估值线索的作用机制，揭示了叙事效应在不同市场条件下的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为艺术品投资者和拍卖行提供了叙事管理的重要性，特别是在信息不对称严重的情况下，叙事一致性可以作为价格预测的参考指标。
