title: Real-Time Lane-Level Crash Detection on Freeways Using Sparse Telematics Data
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison, University of Wisconsin-Madison and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Real-Time Lane-Level Crash Detection on Freeways Using Sparse Telematics Data
detail.abstract: Real-time traffic crash detection is critical in intelligent transportation systems because traditional crash notifications often suffer delays and lack specific, lane-level location information, which can lead to safety risks and economic losses. This paper proposes a real-time, lane-level crash detection approach for freeways that only leverages sparse telematics trajectory data. In the offline stage, the historical trajectories are discretized into spatial cells using vector cross-product techniques, and then are used to estimate a vehicle intention distribution and select an alert threshold by maximizing the F1-score based on official crash reports. In the online stage, incoming real-time telematics records are mapped to these cells and scored for three modules: transition anomalies, speed deviations, and lateral maneuver risks, with scores accumulated into a cell-specific risk map. When any cell’s risk exceeds the alert threshold, the system issuesa prompt warning. Relying solely on telematics data, this real-time and low-cost solution isevaluated on crash data in Wisconsin, achieving a 75% crash identification rate with accurate lane-level localization, an overall accuracy of 96%, an F1-score of 0.84, and and a false alarm rate of only 0.6% among non-crash cases, while also detecting 13% of crashes more than 3 minutes before the crash notification time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于稀疏轨迹数据的实时车道级高速公路事故检测方法，通过离线学习车辆意图分布和在线评估风险，实现高精度的事故预警。
AI.research_question: 如何利用稀疏的车辆轨迹数据实现实时、车道级的高速公路交通事故检测？
AI.motivation: 传统事故通知存在延迟且缺乏具体的车道级位置信息，可能导致安全风险和经济损失，需要一种实时、低成本的事故检测方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于车辆轨迹数据的异常检测理论，包括车辆意图分布估计、空间离散化技术和风险评分模型。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：离线阶段使用向量叉积技术将历史轨迹离散化为空间单元，估计车辆意图分布并基于F1分数最大化选择警报阈值；在线阶段将实时轨迹映射到空间单元，通过三个模块（转移异常、速度偏差、横向操纵风险）评分并累积风险，超过阈值时发出警报。
AI.findings: 在威斯康星州事故数据上的评估显示：75%的事故识别率，准确的车道级定位，整体准确率96%，F1分数0.84，非事故情况下的误报率仅0.6%，13%的事故在事故通知时间前3分钟以上被检测到。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于稀疏轨迹数据的实时事故检测理论框架，发展了车辆意图分布估计和空间风险映射方法，为智能交通系统的异常检测提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种低成本、实时的事故检测系统，仅需稀疏的车辆轨迹数据即可实现车道级精确定位，显著提高了事故响应速度和准确性，具有实际部署价值。

title: Public Acceptance and the Dynamic Evolution of Adopting Carbon Capture and Storage
affiliations: Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), Fridtjof Nansen Institute and Ragnar Frisch Centre for Economic Research

detail.title: Public Acceptance and the Dynamic Evolution of Adopting Carbon Capture and Storage
detail.abstract: Public acceptance has influenced the evolution of carbon capture and storage (CCS) in Europe. To study the mechanisms behind this, we use evolutionary game theory where the governmental policy towards CCS, such as subsidies to the industry, is dependent on public acceptance. Public acceptance further depends on the perceived benefits and costs for individuals of CCS. We show that in this model, multiple equilibria may exist, and the starting point as well as the heterogeneity of firms will determine the equilibrium that will be reached over time. While the subsidy is tied to public acceptance, the government can affect development by correcting other imperfections in the market. Using such policy instruments, a new equilibrium may develop with a higher share of investments in CCS. The model also suggests an explanation of the different situations in many countries today with respect to CCS investments and investment plans.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用演化博弈论分析公众接受度如何影响欧洲碳捕集与封存（CCS）的发展，发现存在多重均衡，初始条件和企业异质性决定最终均衡，政府可通过政策工具推动CCS投资。
AI.research_question: 公众接受度如何影响欧洲碳捕集与封存（CCS）的演化发展？政府政策如何在这一过程中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 公众接受度显著影响了欧洲CCS的发展进程，需要理解其背后的机制以及政府如何通过政策干预来促进CCS投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈理论，其中政府CCS政策（如行业补贴）取决于公众接受度，而公众接受度又取决于个人感知的CCS收益与成本。
AI.method: 建立演化博弈模型，分析政府政策、公众接受度和企业投资决策之间的动态互动关系。
AI.findings: 1. 模型中存在多重均衡；2. 初始条件和企业异质性决定最终达到的均衡；3. 政府可通过纠正市场其他缺陷来影响发展；4. 使用政策工具可形成CCS投资比例更高的新均衡；5. 模型解释了各国CCS投资现状的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将演化博弈论应用于CCS政策分析；2. 建立了公众接受度-政府政策-企业投资的动态框架；3. 揭示了多重均衡的存在和路径依赖特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府制定CCS政策提供理论依据；2. 解释了各国CCS发展差异的原因；3. 提出了通过纠正市场缺陷促进CCS投资的政策建议。

title: Gender Gaps Under Comparable Tasks: Evidence from Quasi-Random Assignment
affiliations: IFAU - Institute for Labour Market Policy Evaluation, Lund University and Uppsala University

detail.title: Gender Gaps Under Comparable Tasks: Evidence from Quasi-Random Assignment
detail.abstract: Gender gaps in earnings persist even among high-skilled workers, partly because men and women often perform different tasks within and across jobs. We study a rare setting in which high-skilled men and women perform the same tasks under comparable conditions, allowing us to assess gender differences in productivity and pay without confounding from task or client allocation. Using administrative data from the Swedish Public Employment Service between 2003 and 2014, we exploit a rotation scheme that quasi-randomly assigns job seekers to employment caseworkers. This ensures male and female caseworkers are matched with comparable clients. We find productivity differences are small: job seekers assigned to female and male caseworkers exit unemployment at similar rates, with no evidence of job-quality differences. Consistent with this, hourly wages—conditional on productivity—are nearly identical across genders. Despite this, female caseworkers earn about 8 percent less per year, due to differences in contracted and actual hours worked. We also find suggestive evidence that male caseworkers are more likely to be promoted than equally productive female colleagues. Overall, when tasks are standardized and performance is measured objectively, gender differences in productivity and hourly pay are minimal, while gaps in annual earnings and career progression persist.

AI.tldr: 在任务标准化、绩效可客观衡量的环境下，高技能男女员工的生产率和小时工资差异极小，但年收入差距和职业晋升差异依然存在。
AI.research_question: 在任务相同、条件可比的高技能工作环境中，性别在生产效率、薪酬和职业发展方面是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 高技能工作者中性别收入差距持续存在，部分原因是男女通常在不同任务和岗位工作。本研究旨在排除任务分配和客户分配等混杂因素，探究纯粹性别差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场性别差异理论，特别是任务分配差异、生产率差异和薪酬歧视理论框架。
AI.method: 利用瑞典公共就业服务局2003-2014年行政数据，采用轮换方案准随机分配求职者给就业顾问，确保男女顾问面对可比客户，进行因果推断分析。
AI.findings: 1) 生产率差异极小：男女顾问帮助求职者退出失业率相似，工作质量无差异；2) 小时工资几乎相同；3) 女性顾问年收入低约8%，源于合同工时和实际工时差异；4) 男性顾问晋升可能性更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明在控制任务和客户分配后，性别生产率差异极小，挑战了生产率差异解释性别收入差距的传统观点；揭示了工时安排和晋升机会是维持性别差距的关键机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计公平薪酬和晋升政策提供证据：应关注工时安排灵活性、合同工时平等和晋升决策中的性别偏见，而非仅关注小时工资平等。

title: God, Guilt, and Giving: Public Good Contribution Among Catholics and Protestants
affiliations: University of Bergamo, Monash University - Department of Economics, University of Bergamo and Catholic University of Milan

detail.title: God, Guilt, and Giving: Public Good Contribution Among Catholics and Protestants
detail.abstract: This paper examines how religious ethic influences contributions to public goods. We develop a theoretical model distinguishing individualistic motivations - where people seek to meet individual moral standards - from collectivistic motivations - where behavior is guided by others' expectations. We argue that the Protestant ethic emphasizes individual responsibility, while the Catholic ethic places greater weight on social expectations. The model predicts that the Protestant contribution share increases with income, whereas the Catholic contribution share is non-monotonic. Moreover, Catholics' overall contribution is relatively higher at lower-middle incomes and lower at higher-middle incomes, while there is no denominational difference in the decision whether to contribute at all. The model also implies that only Catholics' contributions are sensitive to the religious composition of their environment. We test these predictions using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, exploiting variation within individuals. Consistent with the theoretical model, we find (i) no denominational differences at the extensive margin; (ii) at the intensive margin, donations increase with income among Protestants and remain flat among Catholics. These results hold when using the denomination of the parents, suggesting intergenerational transmission of religious ethics. Our findings highlight the role of religious moral structures in shaping cooperative behavior and public-good provision.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨宗教伦理如何影响公共物品贡献，区分个人主义（新教）与集体主义（天主教）动机，发现新教徒捐赠随收入增加而增加，天主教徒捐赠则相对平稳，且天主教徒对环境宗教构成更敏感。
AI.research_question: 宗教伦理（特别是新教与天主教伦理）如何影响个人对公共物品的贡献行为？
AI.motivation: 理解宗教道德结构如何塑造合作行为和公共物品供给，填补宗教伦理对经济行为影响的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分个人主义动机（满足个人道德标准）与集体主义动机（受他人期望引导）的理论模型；新教伦理强调个人责任，天主教伦理更重视社会期望。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与实证检验相结合；使用德国社会经济面板数据，利用个体内变异进行分析；同时使用父母宗教信仰作为工具变量检验代际传递。
AI.findings: 1) 在是否捐赠的广泛边际上无宗派差异；2) 在捐赠强度的集约边际上，新教徒捐赠随收入增加而增加，天主教徒捐赠保持平稳；3) 天主教徒贡献对环境宗教构成更敏感；4) 结果在父母宗教信仰分析中依然成立，表明宗教伦理的代际传递。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立区分个人主义与集体主义宗教动机的理论框架；2) 提出新教与天主教伦理对公共物品贡献的不同影响机制；3) 预测宗教环境对行为调节作用的宗派差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为理解宗教组织在公共物品供给中的作用提供洞见；2) 帮助政策制定者考虑宗教因素设计公共物品供给机制；3) 为跨文化宗教伦理比较研究提供方法论基础。

title: The Response of Debtors to Rate Changes
affiliations: , Nova School of Business and Economics, Goethe University Frankfurt, Goethe University Frankfurt and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: The Response of Debtors to Rate Changes
detail.abstract: How borrowers respond to future changes in the interest rate on their debt matters for the transmission of monetary policy and for household financial stability. Combining bank data, a letter RCT, and a survey, we study this question in the context of the German mortgage market, where since 2022 borrowers have faced high interest rates when their rate fixation period ends. We find that borrower actions substantially reduce the impact of higher rates on monthly payments. Survey responses corroborate high informedness and a strong propensity to prepare for rate changes. The letter intervention does not affect rate beliefs but increases awareness of available options and refinancing among borrowers close to expiration of their rate fixation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过银行数据、信件随机对照试验和调查，分析了德国抵押贷款市场中借款人对利率变化的应对行为。研究发现借款人的主动行为显著降低了高利率对月供的影响，且借款人普遍信息充分并积极为利率变化做准备。
AI.research_question: 借款人对未来债务利率变化如何反应？这些反应如何影响货币政策传导和家庭财务稳定性？
AI.motivation: 自2022年以来，德国抵押贷款市场的借款人在利率固定期结束后面临高利率环境，了解借款人的应对行为对货币政策传导机制和家庭财务稳定性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导理论、家庭金融决策理论和行为经济学框架，研究借款人在利率变化环境下的理性预期和适应性行为。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1）银行数据实证分析；2）信件随机对照试验（RCT）；3）问卷调查，多角度研究德国抵押贷款市场。
AI.findings: 1）借款人的主动应对行为显著降低了高利率对月供的冲击；2）调查显示借款人信息充分且积极为利率变化做准备；3）信件干预不影响利率预期，但提高了临近利率固定期结束的借款人对可用选项和再融资的意识。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化了对货币政策传导中微观行为机制的理解；2）扩展了家庭金融决策理论在利率变化环境下的应用；3）为行为经济学在金融决策中的实证研究提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者设计更有效的货币政策工具提供参考；2）帮助金融机构优化客户服务和风险管理；3）为借款人提供应对利率变化的决策支持。

title: Understanding Post-Pandemic Inflation Fluctuations: The Commodity Cost Channel
affiliations: Ghent University - Department of Financial Economics

detail.title: Understanding Post-Pandemic Inflation Fluctuations: The Commodity Cost Channel
detail.abstract: This paper employs a joint SVAR-IV model for the United States and the euro area to estimate the pass-through of energy and food commodity cost shocks to inflation. Exogenous commodity cost shocks — such as those triggered by the Russian invasion of Ukraine — had only a modest impact on inflation during the post-pandemic period. However, counterfactual analyses based on the pass-through estimates indicate that overall commodity cost fluctuations — including their endogenous responses to macroeconomic conditions — can almost fully account for the rise and subsequent decline of energy, food, and core CPI inflation over this period. These findings highlight that commodity costs constitute a key transmission channel through which macroeconomic developments affect inflation. Estimates of a standard Phillips Curve specification, including its slope, are shown to be severely biased when this channel is ignored.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用联合SVAR-IV模型分析美国和欧元区能源与食品商品成本冲击对通胀的传导效应。研究发现，外生商品成本冲击（如俄乌战争引发的）对疫情后通胀影响有限，但包含内生反应的商品成本波动能完全解释该时期能源、食品和核心CPI通胀的上升与下降。研究强调商品成本是宏观经济影响通胀的关键传导渠道，忽略此渠道会严重偏误标准菲利普斯曲线的估计。
AI.research_question: 能源和食品商品成本冲击如何传导至通胀？外生冲击与内生反应在解释疫情后通胀动态中各自扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解疫情后通胀动态的驱动因素，特别是区分外生商品成本冲击（如地缘政治事件）与宏观经济条件驱动的内生成本波动对通胀的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于SVAR-IV（结构向量自回归-工具变量）模型，结合菲利普斯曲线框架，分析商品成本冲击向通胀的传导机制。
AI.method: 使用美国和欧元区的联合SVAR-IV模型估计商品成本冲击对通胀的传导效应，并进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 1. 外生商品成本冲击（如俄乌战争）对疫情后通胀影响有限；2. 包含内生反应的商品成本波动能几乎完全解释该时期能源、食品和核心CPI通胀的上升与下降；3. 商品成本是宏观经济影响通胀的关键传导渠道；4. 忽略此渠道会严重偏误标准菲利普斯曲线的斜率估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了商品成本作为宏观经济影响通胀的关键传导渠道；2. 揭示了区分外生冲击与内生反应对理解通胀动态的重要性；3. 证明了忽略商品成本渠道会导致菲利普斯曲线估计的严重偏误。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行和政策制定者提供了更准确的分析工具来理解通胀驱动因素；2. 强调了在通胀预测和政策制定中需要考虑商品成本的内生反应；3. 有助于更精准地评估货币政策对通胀的影响。
